ITQAN:v2p425/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p425/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
ITQAN:v2p425/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas praises عن صلاتهم ساهون, meaning heedless of prayer, rather than في صلاتهم, heedless within prayer.
ITQAN:v2p425/r6.anchor: وعن ابن عباس قال الحمد لله الذي قال ﴿ عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ ولم يقل في صلاتهم

BURSEVI:v10p404/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p404/r5.speaker: برهان القرآن
BURSEVI:v10p404/r5.claim: Burhan al-Qur’an explains the repeated “those who are” as a grammatical necessity: the verse does not coordinate a verb directly with a noun, while repeating the phrase allows a verb to follow a verb.
BURSEVI:v10p404/r5.anchor: كرر ولم يقتصر على مرة واحدة لامتناع عطف الفعل على الاسم

QASHANI:107:7/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:107:7/r1.speaker: author
QASHANI:107:7/r1.claim: The woe concerns people whose prayer lacks presence and sincerity; calling them “prayers” indicts them because even their finest outward deed becomes sin without those conditions.
QASHANI:107:7/r1.anchor: إن صلوا غفلوا عن صلاتهم لاحتجابهم عن حقيقتها بجهلهم وعدم حضورهم

QASHANI:107:7/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:107:7/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:107:7/r2.claim: The plural form addresses a class, since the denier of judgment is treated as a generic type.
QASHANI:107:7/r2.anchor: وأورد على صيغة الجمع لأن المراد بالذي يكذب هو الجنس

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p469/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p469/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p469/r4.claim: The custodians appear to pray, but their prayers lack spirit and devotion and are pretentious; insincerity toward God also makes a person a poor neighbour to others.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p469/r4.anchor: their prayers lack spirit and devotion and are in fact a show of pretence on their part

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r6.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r6.claim: Abu al-Aliya says prayer negligence is uncertainty over how many units one has completed.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r6.anchor: فسأل أبا العالية عن قول الله عز وجل ﴿ الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ ما هو فقال أبو العااليه

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r7.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r7.speaker: الحسن
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r7.claim: Hasan rejects Abu al-Aliya's gloss: negligence means letting the prayer's time pass until it is missed.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن مه ليس كذلك ﴿ الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ الذي يسهو عن ميقاتها حتى يفوت

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r8.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r8.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r8.claim: Sa'd says negligence about prayer means abandoning it at its proper time.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#3/r8.anchor: عن الثوري عن الأعمش عن طلحة بن مطرف عن مصعب بن سعد قال سئل سعد عن قوله تعالى ﴿ الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ قال السهو عنها تركها لوقتها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p552/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p552/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p552/r11.claim: The apparent reading makes those praying a separate group; another view identifies them as the orphan-abuser who also fails to urge feeding. The author's likelier explanation is hypocrites who perform prayer outwardly without Muslim belief or devotion.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p552/r11.anchor: والظاهر أن المصلين هم غير المذكور. وقيل: هو داع اليتيم غير الحاض،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r1.speaker: الرسول
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r1.claim: A report explains being heedless about prayer as delaying it beyond its time through disregard.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r1.anchor: وفي الحديث عن صلاتهم ساهون: «يؤخرونها عن وقتها تهاونا بها» .

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r2.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r2.claim: Mujāhid defines heedlessness as delaying, abandoning, and neglecting prayer.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r3.speaker: إبراهيم
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r3.claim: Ibrāhīm says it describes a person who turns his head while prostrating.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r3.anchor: وقال إبراهيم: هو الذي إذا سجد قال برأسه هكذا ملتفتا.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r4.speaker: قتادة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r4.claim: Qatada says it means abandoning prayer or being so careless as not to care whether one has prayed.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة: هو الترك لها، أو هم الغافلون الذين لا يبالي أحدهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r5.speaker: قطرب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r5.claim: Quṭrub says the heedless person does not recite or remember God.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r5.anchor: وقال قطرب: هو الذي لا يقر ولا يذكر الله تعالى.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says hypocrites leave prayer in private, perform it publicly, and rise lazily; the following mention of ostentation supports this reading, also attributed by Ibn Wahb to Mālik.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: المنافقون يتركون الصلاة سرا ويفعلونها علانية،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r7.speaker: ابن عباس وعطاء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the wording عن صلاتهم points to hypocrites, whereas في صلاتهم would concern believers; ʿAṭāʾ thanks God for the chosen wording.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r7.anchor: قال ابن عباس: ولو قال في صلاتهم لكانت في المؤمنين. وقال عطاء: الحمد لله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī offers an alternative syntax joining fa-dhālika to the one who denies judgment, omitting the answer to araʾayta, and making the woe to praying hypocrites a description standing for their pronoun; generic singular carries a plural sense.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p553/r8.anchor: وطريقة أخرى أن يكون فذلك عطفا على الذي يكذب، إما عطف ذات على ذات،

FARRA:v3p294#2/r4.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p294#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
FARRA:v3p294#2/r4.claim: The threatened worshippers are hypocrites who are heedless or lax about prayer; Ibn ʿAbbās gives this interpretation, also found in ʿAbd Allāh's reading.
FARRA:v3p294#2/r4.anchor: فويل للمصلين (4) يعني: المنافقين «الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون» يقول: لاهون كذلك فسرها ابن عباس،

BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r4.claim: The fa in the woe passage is consequential: neglect of the orphan already shows weak religion and deserves blame, so heedlessness of prayer, ostentation, and withholding zakāt merit it even more; prayer is religion's pillar, ostentation a branch of unbelief, and zakāt Islam's bridge.
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r4.anchor: فالسهو عن الصلاة التي هي عماد الدين والرياء الذي هو شعبة من الكفر، ومنع الزكاة التي هي قنطرة الإسلام أحق بذلك

BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r6.claim: Calling them “those who pray” in place of a pronoun signals their bad treatment of both the Creator and other people.
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:6-7/r6.anchor: وإنما وضع المصلين موضع الضمير للدلالة على سوء معاملتهم مع الخالق والخلق

BINTSHATI:v2p189/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r1.speaker: بعض المفسرين
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r1.claim: Some commentators say inattentiveness means missing prayer times; others mean abandoning prayer itself.
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r1.anchor: فصح بذلك قول من قال: عنى بذلك ترك وقتها، وقول من قال: عنى تركها

BINTSHATI:v2p189/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhshari adds careless, distracted performance: rushed movements without humility, fidgeting or looking around, and not knowing what was recited.
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r2.anchor: وأضاف "الزمخشري" إلى هذين الوجهين وجهاً ثالثاً: "أو لا يصلونها كما صلاها رسول الله

BINTSHATI:v2p189/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r3.speaker: الرازي
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r3.claim: Al-Razi objects that calling them prayerful conflicts with interpreting heedlessness as abandonment, and that abandonment alone is not hypocrisy or unbelief.
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r3.anchor: ووقف "الرازي" عند تأويل السهو عن الصلاة بتركها، فأثار فيه مسألتين:

BINTSHATI:v2p189/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r4.speaker: الرازي
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r4.claim: Al-Razi answers that they count as prayerful outwardly while forgetting prayer inwardly, as in the description of people who rise lazily and show off.
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r4.anchor: حكم عليهم بكونهم مصلين نظراً إلى الصورة، وبأنهم نسوا الصلاة نظراً إلى المعنى

BINTSHATI:v2p189/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r5.claim: The author treats the next clauses as attached to the inattentive worshippers: riya is showing people an outward state unlike one's inward one, near hypocrisy but also used more broadly.
BINTSHATI:v2p189/r5.anchor: ولا نفهم الآبة بمعزل عن الآية التالية لها وقد ارتبطت بها ارتباط الصلة بالموصول:

BINTSHATI:v2p191/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p191/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p191/r3.claim: The warned worshippers do perform prayer, but are heedless of standing before the Creator and of prayer's power to curb arrogance and cultivate humility and conscience.
BINTSHATI:v2p191/r3.anchor: قد أثبت أنهم فعلاً يؤدون الصلاة، ولكنهم ساهون عن صلاتهم غافلون عن كونها قياماً بين يدى الخالق

BINTSHATI:v2p191/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p191/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p191/r4.claim: A prayer that leaves its worshipper indifferent to an orphan's needs or a poor person's right to food cannot come from a humble, believing heart; it becomes a show for gain or protection.
BINTSHATI:v2p191/r4.anchor: وصلاة الذي يدع اليتيم ولا يحض على طعام المسكين، لا يمكن أن تقام عن قلب خاشع وضمير مؤمن

BINTSHATI:v2p192/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p192/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p192/r1.claim: The offering teaches that God receives piety, not animal meat or blood; the verse makes inward God-consciousness decisive.
BINTSHATI:v2p192/r1.anchor: وفي آية الحج: {لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماؤها ولكن يناله التقوى منكم} 37.

BINTSHATI:v2p192/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p192/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p192/r2.claim: The verse on righteousness joins prayer and zakat with keeping promises and patience, showing that virtue includes lived faith and care.
BINTSHATI:v2p192/r2.anchor: الصلاة وآتى الزكاة والموفون بعهدهم إذا عاهدوا والصابرين في البأساء والضراء

BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r7.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r7.claim: He notes that people affiliated with Islam may push an orphan from his rights or fail to care for him, discourage feeding the poor, neglect prayer, show off, and withhold zakat or necessities.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r7.anchor: كدع اليتيم , وهو دفعه عن حقه وعدم الرفق به , وعدم الحض على طعام المسكين , والتغافل عن الصلاة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r8.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r8.claim: He reads these traits as those of a denier who expects no judgment, while observing that such acts can occur among Muslims without every person who commits them necessarily being a denier.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r8.anchor: فأخبر سبحانه وتعالى أنه من صفات من يكذب بيوم الدين ولا ينتظر الجزاء والحساب

BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541#2/r9.claim: The author compares this trait-based description to hadiths that call one with four specified traits a pure hypocrite and say a fornicator is not a believer while committing the act.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r1.claim: Al-Anfal 8:4 describes true believers as those who establish prayer and spend from God's provision, connecting with al-Ma'un's themes of prayer and giving.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r1.anchor: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ومما رزقناهم ينفقون أولئك هم المؤمنون حقا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r2.claim: The surah has twenty-five words; counting from the beginning of prophethood points to year twelve AH, when Abu Bakr had eliminated the apostates and zakat-refusers, exposing their earlier prayer and almsgiving as mere show.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r2.anchor: وذلك أن عدة كلماته خمس وعشرون كلمة فإذا اعتبرتها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r3.claim: Abu Bakr's campaigns ended in that year with the defeat of Banu Hanifa at Yamama, people of al-Nujayr in Kindah, and al-Aswad al-Ansi in Sanaa.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r3.anchor: ولم تمض تلك السنة إلا وقد فرغ منهم بالفراغ من بني حنيفة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r4.claim: The twenty-five words plus the four-word basmala point to year sixteen AH: Arab polytheists, Christians, and Magians had left the peninsula, most converting and the rest going to Byzantine lands.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r4.anchor: وما مضت سنة ست عشرة الموازية لعدد الكلمات بالبسملة - وذلك في أوائل خلافة الفاروق

BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r5.claim: The woe fell on showy worshippers who had been invited by their Prophet to pray but turned away, while other people followed them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r5.anchor: فحل الويل بالمرائين من أهل الصلاة فإنهم الذين أتى إليهم نبيهم صلى الله عليه وسلم بالصلاة فأعرضوا عنها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r6.claim: Counting pronouns is unsuitable because the religion had become openly manifest and unobstructed; counting letters is also unnecessary after its public triumph became clear.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p545/r6.anchor: ولم يصح في هذه السورة اعتبار الضمائر لأن الدين في هذا الحد كان قد ظهر على كل ظاهر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r6.claim: Sahw literally means inadvertent forgetfulness, but here it sarcastically means deliberate neglect; genuine forgetfulness in prayer is not the target because it is excused for this community.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r6.anchor: والسهو حقيقته : الذهول عن أمر سبق علمه ، وهو هنا مستعار للإعراض

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r7.claim: The deliberate-neglect sense parallels “forgetting” one's associates as turning away, and being heedless of signs in al-Aʿraf and Yunus.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p568/r7.anchor: ومثله استعارة الغفلة للإعراض في قوله تعالى : { بأنهم كذبوا بآياتنا وكانوا عنها غافلين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r9.claim: The Prophet tells Saʿd ibn Abi Waqqas that heedlessness of prayer means delaying it beyond its proper time, through abandonment and neglect.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r9.anchor: قال سعد بن أبي وقاص: سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون، فقال: هم الذين يؤخرونها عن وقتها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r10.speaker: مجاهد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r10.claim: Mujahid likewise takes heedlessness as delaying the prayer through neglect.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r11.speaker: قتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r11.claim: Qatada says the heedless abandon prayer and do not care whether they perform it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r11.anchor: وقال قتادة ساهون، هو الترك لها وهم الغافلون الذين لا يبالي أحدهم صلى أو لم يصل،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r12.speaker: عطاء بن يسار
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r12.claim: Ata ibn Yasar praises the wording from their prayer, rather than in their prayer.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r12.anchor: وقال عطاء بن يسار: الحمد لله الذي قال عن صلاتهم ولم يقل في صلاتهم،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r13.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r13.claim: Ibn Masud's reading substitutes lahun, heedless, for sahun.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p527#2/r13.anchor: وفي قراءة ابن مسعود: «لاهون» بدل ساهون،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r1.claim: A report from Abū Barza says the warning about prayer neglect is better than receiving the whole world: the heedless person neither hopes for good from prayer nor fears God if abandoning it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r1.anchor: عن أبي برزة الأسلمي قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لما نزلت هذه الآية

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r2.claim: Ibn Kathīr calls this report weak because its chain contains Jābir al-Juʿfī and an unnamed teacher.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r2.anchor: فيه جابر الجعفي، وهو ضعيف، وشيخه مبهم لم يسم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r3.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r3.claim: A report from Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ identifies the heedless as those who delay prayer beyond its appointed time.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r3.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد، عن سعد بن أبي وقاص قال: سألت رسول الله

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r4.claim: Delaying prayer may mean abandoning it entirely, performing it after its legally appointed time, or letting its time expire through forgetful delay from the beginning of the time.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r4.anchor: وتأخير الصلاة عن وقتها يحتمل تركها بالكلية، أو صلاتها بعد وقتها شرعا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r5.claim: Ibn Kathīr says the mawqūf version of the report is more sound; al-Bayhaqī weakened its Prophetic attribution and authenticated its attribution to Saʿd, as did al-Ḥākim.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p495/r5.anchor: وهذا أصح إسنادا، وقد ضعف البيهقي (9) رفعه، وصحح وقفه، وكذلك الحاكم

JISHUMI:v10p7555/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r1.speaker: ابن عباس، الحسن، عكرمة، قتادة
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas, al-Hasan, Ikrima, and Qatada classify the seven-verse sura as Meccan.
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r1.anchor: قيل: مكية، عن ابن عباس، والحسن، وعكرمة، وقتادة

JISHUMI:v10p7555/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r2.speaker: الضحاك، الواقدي
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r2.claim: Al-Dahhak and al-Waqidi classify the sura as Medinan.

JISHUMI:v10p7555/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r3.speaker: مقاتل
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r3.claim: Muqatil says it is Meccan through the mention of the needy, with the remainder Medinan.
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r3.anchor: مكية إلى قوله: (المسكين) وباقي السورة مدنية، عن مقاتل

JISHUMI:v10p7555/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r4.speaker: النبي
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r4.claim: A report transmitted from Ubayy says reciting this sura brings God's forgiveness for one who pays zakat; no grading is given.
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r4.anchor: وعن أبي، عن النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم -: من قرأ سورة (أرأيت) غفر الله له

JISHUMI:v10p7555/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r5.claim: After recounting favors to Quraysh, the sura marvels at their conduct despite Meccan security and provision, then their denial of the Prophet and his prophethood.
JISHUMI:v10p7555/r5.anchor: افتتح هذه السورة تعجبا من حالهم مع عظم النعم عليهم بمكة من الأمن والرزق

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r1.claim: The Prophet himself experienced forgetfulness in prayer, so jurists included a chapter on prostration for forgetfulness in their books.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r1.anchor: وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقع له السهو في صلاته فضلا عن غيره ؛ ومن ثم أثبت الفقهاء باب سجود السهو في كتبهم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r2.speaker: أنس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r2.claim: Anas says, Praise God that the verse did not say they are heedless in their prayers.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r2.anchor: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه : الحمد لله على أن لم يقل في صلاتهم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p809/r3.claim: Ibn Masud's reading is لاهون, heedless or distracted.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r17.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r17.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r17.claim: Mujahid says being heedless of prayer means being distracted and careless.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r17.anchor: أحدها : أن معنى ساهون أي لاهون , قاله مجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r19.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r19.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r19.claim: Al-Hasan says they do not pray in private but do so publicly to display themselves to believers.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r19.anchor: الثالث : أن لا يصليها سرا ويصليها علانية رياء للمؤمنين , قاله الحسن .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r20.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r20.speaker: أبو العالية
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r20.claim: Abu al-Aliya says they turn their gaze right and left and treat prayer carelessly.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r20.anchor: الرابع : هو الذي يلتفت يمنة ويسرة وهوانا بصلاته , قاله أبو العالية .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r21.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r21.speaker: قطرب
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r21.claim: Qutrub says they neither recite nor remember God.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r21.anchor: الخامس : هو ألا يقرأ ولا يذكر الله , قاله قطرب .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r22.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r22.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r22.claim: Musab ibn Sa'd reports from his father that the Prophet said they delay prayer beyond its appointed times; Mawardi says involuntary distraction during prayer is excused.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p350#2/r22.anchor: السادس : هو ما روى مصعب بن سعد بن أبي وقاص عن أبيه قال : سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن

MUQATIL:107:1-7/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:107:1-7/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:107:1-7/r6.claim: They are inattentive to prayer until its time passes, even if they pray it during that interval.
MUQATIL:107:1-7/r6.anchor: يعني لاهون عنها، حتى يذهب وقتها، وإن كانوا في خلال ذلك يصلونها

NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r3.speaker: أنس والحسن
NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r3.claim: Anas and al-Hasan praise the wording 'about their prayer' rather than 'in their prayer': the former means neglecting and disregarding it, a hypocritical trait.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r3.anchor: وعن انس والحسن قالا الحمد لله الذى قال عن بصلاتهم ولم يقل فى صلاتهم لأن معنى عن أنهم ساهون عنها سهو ترك لها وقلة التفات إليها

NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r4.claim: Being distracted during prayer by Satan's whispers or one's thoughts can happen to any Muslim, even the Prophet, and differs from neglecting prayer itself.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p359#4/r4.anchor: وذلك فعل المنافقين ومعنى فى أن السهو يعتريهم فيها بوسوسة شيطان أو حديث نفس وذلك لا يخلو عنه مسلم وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقع له السهو فى صلاته

ZAJJAJ:v5p367#2/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p367#2/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p367#2/r2.claim: Another interpretation says they are heedless because they delay prayer past its time; whoever deliberately delays until the next prayer time begins also faces woe.
ZAJJAJ:v5p367#2/r2.anchor: ومن تعمد تأخيرها عن وقتها حتى يدخل وقت غيرها فالويل له أيضا

STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r1.claim: Most call al-Māʿūn an early Makkan sūrah after al-Takāthur, though some assign vv. 4–7 to Madinah; since the whole sūrah addresses religious hypocrisy, it may all be Madinan, when hypocrisy could gain political advantage.
STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r1.anchor: commentators maintain that al-Māʿūn is an early Makkan sūrah

STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r2.claim: Religious hypocrisy is not treated as limited to Muslims alone.
STUDYQURAN:107:intro/r2.anchor: Nonetheless, hypocrisy in religion was not seen as limited to Muslims alone.

ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r1.claim: The surah was revealed in the mission's early years, probably after surah 102; its title comes from al-ma'un in the last verse.
ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r1.anchor: revealed in the early years of the Prophet's mission (probably after surah 102), is derived from the word al-ma'un occurring in the last verse

ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r2.speaker: some commentators
ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r2.claim: Some commentators date verses 4–7 to Medina, but Asad rejects this view for lack of historical or textual evidence.
ASAD-NOTES:107:intro/r2.anchor: The view of some commentators that verses 4-7 were revealed at Medina lacks all historical or textual evidence and may, therefore, be disregarded.

CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r1.claim: The second section opens with the emphatic wail that introduces a catalogue of vices.
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r1.anchor: einen rhetorisch markanten Einsatzpunkt auf, nämlich die einen Lasterkatalog einleitende Interjektion „Wehe …“ (wail)

CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r2.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r2.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r2.claim: Verses 4–6 target the criticized people's neglect of ritual prayer.
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r2.anchor: Die anschließenden Verse zielen zunächst (V. 4–6) auf die kultische Nachlässigkeit der Getadelten ab

CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r4.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r4.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r4.claim: The two groups cross-correspond: verse 1 and verses 4–6 concern religious omissions, while verses 2–3 and verse 7 concern social omissions; the first group stresses social failings and the second religious ones.
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-7:kommentar/r4.anchor: Inhaltlich korrespondieren insofern V. 1 und V. 4–6 (religiöse Unterlassungen) und V. 2.3 und V. 7 (soziale Unterlassungen)

TABATABAI:107:1-7/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r1.claim: The surah warns people professing religion whose traits resemble hypocrites: neglecting prayer, acting ostentatiously, and withholding aid, all incompatible with belief in requital.
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r1.anchor: بيان وعيد لمن كان من المنتحلين بالدين متخلقا بأخلاق المنافقين

TABATABAI:107:1-7/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r2.claim: The surah may be Meccan or Medinan; another view says its first half is Meccan and second half Medinan.
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r2.anchor: والسورة تحتمل المكية والمدنية، وقيل نصفها مكي ونصفها مدني

TABATABAI:107:1-7/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r10.claim: Those heedless of prayer do not care if they miss it entirely, miss some prayers, or delay it beyond its preferred time.
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r10.anchor: أي غافلون لا يهتمون بها ولا يبالون أن تفوتهم بالكلية أو بعض الأوقات

TABATABAI:107:1-7/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r11.claim: The consequence-marker applies the denier of requital to these praying people; they display belief while practically denying requital, so they are not free of hypocrisy.
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r11.anchor: وفي الآية تطبيق من يكذب بالدين على هؤلاء المصلين لمكان فاء التفريع

TABATABAI:107:1-7/r15.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r15.speaker: أبو عبد الله عليه السلام
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r15.claim: In al-Qummi's report, 'heedless of their prayer' means people who abandon prayer; everyone may forget during prayer, while Abu Abd Allah explains it as delaying prayer past its first time without excuse.
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r15.anchor: قال عنى به تاركين لأن كل إنسان يسهو في الصلاة قال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام تأخير الصلاة

TABATABAI:107:1-7/r16.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r16.speaker: علي عليه السلام
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r16.claim: A report from Ali says prayer is God's most beloved deed, worldly matters must not distract from its times, and the condemned are heedless and treat prayer times lightly.
TABATABAI:107:1-7/r16.anchor: ليس عمل أحب إلى الله عز وجل من الصلاة فلا يشغلنكم عن أوقاتها شيء من أمور الدنيا

TABATABAI:107:5-7/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:5-7/r1.speaker: عبد صالح عليه السلام
TABATABAI:107:5-7/r1.claim: Asked about those heedless of prayer, the righteous servant replies that it means neglect.
TABATABAI:107:5-7/r1.anchor: عن قول الله عز وجل { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال هو التضييع

TABATABAI:107:5-7/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:107:5-7/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:107:5-7/r2.claim: Other narrations convey the same meanings about prayer neglect.

TABRISI:107:5-7/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r1.speaker: علي، ابن عباس
TABRISI:107:5-7/r1.claim: Ali and Ibn Abbas are cited for the view that these are hypocrites who delay prayer until its time passes, then pray for show among believers and omit it when alone, expecting no reward and fearing no penalty.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r1.anchor: فإذا كانوا مع المؤمنين صلوها رياء وإذا لم يكونوا معهم لم يصلوا وهو قوله { الذين هم يراؤون } عن علي ع وابن عباس

TABRISI:107:5-7/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r2.speaker: أنس
TABRISI:107:5-7/r2.claim: Anas notes that the verse says they are heedless about prayer, not within prayer; involuntary distraction during prayer is not punished.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r2.anchor: وقال أنس: الحمد لله الذي قال عن صلاتهم ولم يقل في صلاتهم

TABRISI:107:5-7/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r3.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:107:5-7/r3.claim: Qatada says they are heedless about prayer because they do not care whether they pray or leave it.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r3.anchor: ساهون عنها لا يبالون صلوا أم لم يصلوا عن قتادة

TABRISI:107:5-7/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r4.speaker: الضحاك
TABRISI:107:5-7/r4.claim: Al-Dahhak identifies them as those who abandon prayer.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r4.anchor: هم الذين يتركون الصلاة عن الضحاك

TABRISI:107:5-7/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r5.speaker: الحسن
TABRISI:107:5-7/r5.claim: Al-Hasan says they pray only for show and feel no regret when they miss prayer.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r5.anchor: إن صلوها صلوها رياء وإن فاتتهم لم يندموا عن الحسن

TABRISI:107:5-7/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
TABRISI:107:5-7/r6.claim: Abu al-Aliya says they fail to pray at the appointed times and do not complete bowing or prostration.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r6.anchor: لا يصلونها لمواقيتها ولا يتمون ركوعها ولا سجودها عن أبي العالية

TABRISI:107:5-7/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r7.speaker: أبو العالية
TABRISI:107:5-7/r7.claim: Abu al-Aliya also describes a person who turns his head this way and that while prostrating.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r7.anchor: وعنه أيضا قال هو الذي إذا سجد قال برأسه هكذا وهكذا ملتفتا

TABRISI:107:5-7/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r8.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:107:5-7/r8.claim: In a report from Yunus ibn Ammar, Abu Abdillah rejects interpreting the verse as satanic whispering, which everyone experiences; he means neglecting prayer and failing to pray at its first time.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r8.anchor: عن يونس بن عمار عن أبي عبد الله ع قال سألته عن قوله { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } أهي وسوسة الشيطان فقال لا

TABRISI:107:5-7/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r9.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:107:5-7/r9.claim: Abu Abdillah explains heedlessness as abandoning prayer and treating it casually, in a report from Abu Usama Zayd al-Shahham.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r9.anchor: أبي أسامة زيد الشحام قال سألت أبا عبد الله ع عن قول الله الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون قال هو الترك لها والتواني عنها

TABRISI:107:5-7/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:5-7/r10.speaker: أبو الحسن
TABRISI:107:5-7/r10.claim: Abu al-Hasan explains the heedlessness as wasting the prayer, in a report from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl.
TABRISI:107:5-7/r10.anchor: وعن محمد ابن الفضيل عن أبي الحسن ع قال هو التضييع لها

THALABI:v10p305/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p305/r1.speaker: عطاء بن دينار
THALABI:v10p305/r1.claim: He notes that the wording condemns those heedless of prayer, not those merely heedless during prayer.
THALABI:v10p305/r1.anchor: الحمد لله الذي قال: الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ولم يقل في صلاتهم

THALABI:v10p305/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p305/r2.speaker: الحسن
THALABI:v10p305/r2.claim: He says the person prays for show and feels no regret when missing the prayer.
THALABI:v10p305/r2.anchor: هو الذي إن صلاها صلاها رياء وأن فاتته لم يندم

THALABI:v10p305/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p305/r3.speaker: أبو العالية
THALABI:v10p305/r3.claim: He says they fail to pray at the proper times and do not complete bowing and prostration.
THALABI:v10p305/r3.anchor: لا يصلونها لمواقيتها ولا يتمون ركوعها ولا سجودها

THALABI:v10p305/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p305/r4.speaker: أبو العالية
THALABI:v10p305/r4.claim: He also says they turn their heads back and forth while prostrating.
THALABI:v10p305/r4.anchor: إذا سجد قال برأسه هكذا وهكذا ملتفتا

ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r1.claim: Religious pretenders who neglect prayer, show off, and withhold even small help are more astonishingly blameworthy than disbelievers who deny religion and mistreat orphans and the poor.
ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r1.anchor: namaz kılar dindar görünüp de namazlarından yanılan, mürâîlik, gösteriş yapıp

ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r3.claim: After the address to the Prophet to see and understand, Sūrat al-Kawthar condenses the preceding suras, especially those from al-Ḍuḥā, as a final account of Muhammad's rank.
ELMALILI:107:2-7#3/r3.anchor: Ve’d-Duhâ’dan beri gelen sûrelerin mazmûnu üzerinde hepsinin tetimmesi

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r3.claim: Lapse through heedlessness has two kinds: without one's agency it is excused, but self-produced lapse, such as drunken misconduct, is accountable and meant here.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r3.anchor: أحدهما أن لا يكون من الإنسان جواليه وبوالداته كمجنون سب إنسانا والثاني أن يكون منه مولداته

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r4.claim: The wording means heedless of prayer—neglecting it and caring little about it—as hypocrites or sinful believers do; it does not mean involuntary distraction during prayer.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r4.anchor: ساهون عن صلاتهم سهو ترك لها وقلة التفات إليها وعدم مبالاة بها وذلك فعل المنافقين

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r5.speaker: أنس
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r5.claim: Anas thanks God that the verse says heedless of their prayers rather than heedless while performing them, which would describe a nearly unavoidable distraction.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r5.anchor: قال أنس رضي الله عنه الحمدعلى أن لم يقل في صلاهم

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r6.claim: When the verse was revealed, the Prophet said it was better for the hearers than receiving the whole world.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r6.anchor: قال عليه السلام : "هذه خير لكم من أن يعطي كل واحد منكم مثل جميع الدنيا"

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r7.claim: The Prophet himself missed or shortened prayers in reported circumstances: during the Trench battle, while traveling at Fajr, and once at noon before completing two more units.

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r8.claim: His lapses are unlike those of other people because of his constant absorption and spiritual attraction; he said his eyes sleep while his heart does not.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r8.anchor: لكن سهوه عليه السلام فيما ذكر وفي غيره ليس كسهور

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r9.claim: Inwardly, the verse warns against missing the subtle realities and sciences of prayer through heedlessness.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r9.anchor: وفيه إشارة إلى السهو عن شهود لطائف الصلاة

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r10.speaker: ابن مسعود
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r10.claim: Ibn Masʿūd's reading has لاهون in place of ساهون.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r10.anchor: وقرأ ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه لاهون مكان ساهون

BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r11.claim: Prayer is a kind of ascent and intimate conversation, so one should avoid playing with clothes, yawning, looking around, or losing track of the recitation and units.
BURSEVI:v10p403#2/r11.anchor: فعلى العاقل أن تفوته الصلاة التي هي من باب المعراج والمناجاة ولا يعبث فيها باللحية والثياب

SULAMI:v2p421/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p421/r1.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p421/r1.claim: The heedless fail to attend prayer with the heart, observe the rights of intimate communion, or humble their limbs, unaware that prayer connects servants to their Lord.
SULAMI:v2p421/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم : الذين لا يحضرونها بشهود قلب ، ورعاية حق المناجاة ، وخشوع الجوارح

SULAMI:v2p421/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p421/r2.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p421/r2.claim: He says this is the Qur'an's uniquely severe warning without a tender promise afterward: it threatens those who pray without heart-presence, so abandonment or abuse is worse.
SULAMI:v2p421/r2.anchor: سمعت أبا العباس بن عطاء يقول : ليس في القرآن وعيد صعب إلا وبعده وعد لطيف

SULAMI:v2p421/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p421/r3.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p421/r3.claim: Prayer is a connection with God whose nature only God knows.
SULAMI:v2p421/r3.anchor: وسئل ما الصلاة ؟ فقال : اتصال بالله من حيث لا يعلمه إلا الله

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#2/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies these worshippers as hypocrites who pray for show when seen, abandon prayer when alone, and withhold household loans out of spite; these loans are al-ma'un.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون قال : هم المنافقون يراءون الناس بصلاتهم اذا حضروا

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r1.speaker: سعيد بن أبي وقاص
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r1.claim: Sa'id ibn Abi Waqqas says the Prophet explained heedlessness as delaying prayer beyond its prescribed time.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r1.anchor: عن سعيد بن أبي وقاص قال : سالت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن قوله : الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون قال هم الذين يؤخرون الصلاة عن وقتها

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r2.speaker: مسروق
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r2.claim: Masruq explains heedlessness as neglecting prayer's appointed time.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r2.anchor: عن مسروق قوله : عن صلاتهم ساهون قال : تضيع ميقاتها

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r3.claim: Mujahid glosses being heedless of prayer as being distracted.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد قوله : عن صلاتهم ساهون قال : لاهون

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r4.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r4.claim: Abu al-Aliya says it describes someone who prays while turning to the right and left.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3468#3/r4.anchor: عن أبي العالية قوله : عن صلاتهم ساهون قال : هو الذي يصلي ويقول هكذا وهكذا يعني يلتفت

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r2.claim: The fā explicitly links the warning to the preceding description; on a wholly Meccan reading, the same denier neglects prayer, performs it for show, and withholds aid.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r2.anchor: موقع الفاء صريح في اتصال ما بعدها بما قبلها من الكلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r3.claim: Calling them “prayers” is mockery: they do not truly pray and are not Muslims, as in 74:43–44; naming them explicitly avoids an awkward list of six traits.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r3.anchor: فوصفهم ب ( المصلين ) إذن تهكم ، والمراد عدمه ، أي الذين لا يصلون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r4.claim: The placement of wayl before the explicit noun signals punishment for all the preceding vices, as al-Kashshaf hints.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r4.anchor: إلى أن الويل ناشىء عن جميع تلك الصفات التي هو أهلها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r5.speaker: مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r5.claim: Ibn Wahb and Ashhab transmit from Malik the Medinan interpretation that these heedless prayers are hypocrites.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r5.anchor: وروى هذا ابن وهب وأشهب عن مالك

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r6.claim: The plural fits the generic deniers; if a particular person is intended, it generalizes the warning to others sharing neglect of prayer, ostentation, and refusal of aid.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p566/r6.anchor: وجيء في هذه الصفة بصيغة الجمع لأن المراد ب { الذي يكذب بالدين }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r1.claim: The relative clause restricts the warning to prayer-neglecters and reinforces the taunting use of “prayers.”
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r1.anchor: وقوله : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } صفة { للمصلين } مقيدة لحكم الموصوف

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r2.claim: Sahun is followed by ʿan to convey abandoning prayer; the verse does not concern legal rulings about forgetfulness during prayer.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r2.anchor: وعدي { ساهون } بحرف { عن } لإفادة أنهم تجاوزوا إقامة صلاتهم وتركوها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r3.claim: They may pray only to be seen, abandoning prayer when alone, or pray without intention and sincerity; in either case calling them heedless is mockery.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r3.anchor: يجوز أن يكون معناه الذين لا يؤدون الصلاة إلا رياء فإذا خلوا تركوا الصلاة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r4.claim: Riyāʾ means presenting a false good appearance so people praise one; samʿa is often paired with it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r4.anchor: و ( يراءون ) يقصدون أن يرى الناس أنهم على حال حسن وهم بخلافه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r5.claim: The verb is attested only in form III, whose reciprocal pattern suits repeated acts of showing.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r5.anchor: وهذا الفعل وارد في الكلام على صيغة المفاعلة ولم يسمع منه فعل مجرد لأنه يلازمه تكرير الإراءة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r6.claim: Al-Maʿun can mean financial assistance: they withhold surplus wealth or charity, which was obligatory early on before fixed zakat.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r6.anchor: يمنعون فضلهم أو يمنعون الصدقة على الفقراء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r7.speaker: سعيد بن المسيب
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r7.claim: Said ibn al-Musayyab and Ibn Shihab say maʿun means money in Quraysh dialect.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r7.anchor: وقال سعيد بن المسيب وابن شهاب : الماعون : المال بلسان قريش

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r8.speaker: مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r8.claim: Ashhab transmits Malik's view that maʿun means zakat; al-Raʿi's poem pairs it with prayer, meaning zakat and prayer.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r8.anchor: وروى أشهب عن مالك : الماعون : الزكاة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r9.claim: Maʿun can also mean household utensils and tools whose lending costs the owner nothing.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r9.anchor: ويطلق على ما يستعان به على عمل البيت من آنية وآلات طبخ وشد وحفر ونحو ذلك مما لا خسارة على صاحبه في إعارته

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r10.speaker: عائشة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r10.claim: Aisha interprets maʿun as water, fire, and salt.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r10.anchor: وعن عائشة : الماعون الماء والنار والملح

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r11.claim: This reading condemns miserliness at its worst: refusing things that cost nothing to lend.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p567/r11.anchor: وهذا ذم لهم بمنتهى البخل . وهو الشح بما لا يزرئهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r1.claim: The passage concerns hypocrites who expect reward for praying in the Prophet's presence but do not fear punishment when they skip prayer, so they pray for show when he is there and leave it otherwise.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r1.anchor: نزل هذا في المنافقين الذين يرجون لصلاتهم ثوابا ولا يخافون على تركها عقابا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r2.claim: Ibn Masud says they did not abandon prayer entirely—doing so would be unbelief—but failed to keep its appointed times.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن مسعود والله ما تركوها البتة ولو تركوها البتة كانوا كفارا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas says they delay their prayers beyond their proper times.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r3.anchor: وقال ابن عباس يؤخرونها عن وقتها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r4.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r4.claim: Abu al-Aliya says the person is so heedless that he does not know how many units he has prayed, even or odd.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r4.anchor: ونقل عن أبي العالية أنه قال هو الذي لا يدري عن كم انصرف عن شفع أو عن وتر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r5.speaker: بعض العلماء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r5.claim: Some scholars reject this interpretation because the Prophet himself once forgot in prayer, the verse says 'about their prayer' rather than 'within it,' and such forgetfulness is beyond ordinary human ability.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r5.anchor: ورد هذا بعض العلماء فقال هذا ليس بشيء لأن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قد سها في صلاته

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r6.claim: The author thinks Abu al-Aliya meant habitual, not rare, forgetfulness: persistent inattention shows a heart that does not respect prayer, which is what the verse condemns.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p244#2/r6.anchor: ولا أظن أبا العالية أراد السهو النادر وإنما أراد السهو الدائم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس وغيره
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r4.claim: They identify the threatened worshippers as hypocrites who pray publicly but do not pray in private.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس، وغيره: يعني المنافقين،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r5.claim: One explanation of being heedless of prayer is abandoning prayer altogether.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r6.speaker: مسروق وأبو الضحى
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r6.claim: Another explanation is letting the prayer's legally prescribed time expire.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r7.claim: The phrase also covers habitually delaying prayer until the end of its time, neglecting its pillars or conditions, or lacking reverence and reflection; each incurs a share of the warning.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r7.anchor: فاللفظ يشمل هذا كله، ولكن من اتصف بشيء

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r8.speaker: عطاء بن دينار
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r8.claim: He notes the wording says heedless “of” their prayers, not heedless “within” prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r8.anchor: وقال عطاء بن دينار: والحمد لله الذي قال:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r9.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r9.claim: In the canonical collections, the Prophet likens the hypocrite's prayer to waiting for sunset, then pecking out four units with little remembrance.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r9.anchor: يجلس يرقب الشمس، حتى إذا كانت بين قرني الشيطان

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r10.claim: The example is the late Asr prayer, performed without calm or reverence and perhaps only for show, like the hypocrites described elsewhere.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p493#2/r10.anchor: ولعله إنما حمله على القيام إليها مراءاة الناس،

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r1.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r1.claim: For those who are not hypocrites, heedlessness means neglecting prayer with a distracted heart and little regard for it; the show-off is blamed for carelessness, unlike the hypocrite blamed for hypocrisy.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r1.anchor: يغفل عن صلاته، ويقصر فيها، وقلبه مشغول بغيرها، لا يرى لها منزلة

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r2.speaker: ابن عباس، ومسروق
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r2.claim: The heedless delay their prayers beyond their appointed times.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r2.anchor: وقيل: ساهون: يؤخرونها عن وقتها، عن ابن عباس، ومسروق

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r3.speaker: سعيد
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r3.claim: Sa'id says he asked the Prophet about the verse and was told it concerns people who delay prayer past its time.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r3.anchor: سألت رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - عن هذه الآية فقال: الذين يؤخرون الصلاة عن وقتها

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r4.speaker: مجاهد
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r4.claim: Another view describes people distracted from prayer even while performing it.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r4.anchor: وقيل: لاهون عنها مع أدائها، عن مجاهد

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r5.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r5.claim: Another view describes one who prays only for show and feels no regret when missing prayer.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r5.anchor: وقيل: هو الذي إن صلاها صلاها رياء، وإن فاتته لم يندم

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r6.claim: Abu al-Aliya says they miss prayer times and fail to complete bowing and prostration; another report from him identifies one who looks around.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r6.anchor: لا يصلونها بمواقيتها، ولا يتمون ركوعها وسجودها، عن أبي العالية

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r7.claim: The blameworthy heedlessness must be the servant's own act rather than God's act, so that the rebuke makes sense.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r7.anchor: والأظهر - بل الواجب - أنه أراد بالسهو ما هو فعل العبد، دون ما هو فعل الله

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r8.claim: The verse most fittingly addresses hypocrites, since they perform deeds for people to see and the surah opens by describing deniers.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r8.anchor: والأولى أن تحمل الآية على أهل النفاق؛ لأن أول السورة في المكذبين

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r9.claim: Although hypocrites' acts are not genuine prayer, the outward form lets the verse call them prayer by extension, as another verse calls their false religion religion.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r9.anchor: لأن صورته صورة الصلاة، فسماه صلاة توسعا

JISHUMI:v10p7559/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r10.speaker: عطاء بن دينار
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r10.claim: The wording says heedless about their prayer rather than heedless within it: the former leaves prayer, while the latter still performs it, which better suits hypocrites.
JISHUMI:v10p7559/r10.anchor: الحمد لله الذي قال: (الذين هم عن صلاتهم) ولم يقل: (في صلاتهم)

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r15.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r15.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r15.claim: عن صلاتهم means neglecting prayer altogether, characteristic of hypocrites or wicked Muslims; في صلاتهم means distractions within prayer, common to Muslims.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r15.anchor: قلت : معنى : ( عن ) : أنهم ساهون عنها سهو ترك لها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r16.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r16.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r16.claim: In-prayer distraction may arise from Satanic whispering or inner thoughts, which scarcely any Muslim avoids.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p808/r16.anchor: ومعنى ( في ) : أن السهو يعتريهم فيها بوسوسة شيطان

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r1.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r1.claim: Sa‘d ibn Abi Waqqas says this is not ordinary distracting thoughts in prayer, which everyone has; it means neglecting prayer by missing its appointed time.
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r1.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد بن أبي وقاص في قوله ﴿ الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ قال سألت أبي فقلت أهو حديث أحدنا يحدث نفسه في صلاته

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r2.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r2.claim: Ibn Masud’s reading has “they are heedless of their prayers” instead of “they are inattentive about their prayers.”
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r2.anchor: قال في قراءة ابن مسعود عن صلاتهم لاهون

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r3.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r3.speaker: الحسن
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r3.claim: Al-Hasan says neglecting prayer means delaying it beyond its proper time.
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r3.anchor: سمعت الحسن يقول السهو عنها تأخيرها عن وقتها

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r4.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r4.speaker: الحسن
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r4.claim: Another explanation from al-Hasan describes someone who prays for show and feels no regret when missing prayer.
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r4.anchor: عن الحسن قال هو الذي إن صلى صلى رياء وإن فاتته لم يندم

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r5.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r5.speaker: أبو برزة الأسلمي
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r5.claim: Abu Barza al-Aslami reports the Prophet’s saying that this warning is better than possessing the whole world; it describes prayer that inspires no hope and abandonment that inspires no fear of God.
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r5.anchor: حدثني من سمع أبا برزة الاسلمي يقول لما نزلت ﴿ الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الله أكبر

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r6.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r6.claim: Abu al-Aliya says the heedless worshipper turns this way and that during prayer, glancing to the right and left.
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r6.anchor: سألت أبا العالية عن هذه الآية فقال هو الذي إذا صلى صنع هكذا وهكذا يلتفت عن يمينه وعن شماله

MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r7.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r7.speaker: عكرمة، مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r7.claim: Ikrima and Mujahid say neglecting prayer means abandoning it and not performing it.
MUJAHID:v2p786#2/r7.anchor: سألت عنها عكرمة ومجاهدا فقالا السهو عنها تركها فلا يصليها

NAHHAS:v5p295/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p295/r10.speaker: أبو العالية
NAHHAS:v5p295/r10.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliyah says these are people who perform prostration with distraction, gesturing or looking right and left.
NAHHAS:v5p295/r10.anchor: قال أبو العالية هو الذي يسجد ويقول هكذا وهكذا أو التفت عن يمينه وشماله

NAHHAS:v5p295/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p295/r11.speaker: سعد بن مالك
NAHHAS:v5p295/r11.claim: Saʿd ibn Mālik says everyone experiences thoughts during prayer, but the censured person neglects prayer at its appointed time.
NAHHAS:v5p295/r11.anchor: عن سعد بن مالك قال له رجل

NAHHAS:v5p295/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p295/r12.speaker: النبي
NAHHAS:v5p295/r12.claim: In another transmission, Saʿd says he asked the Prophet, who answered that they delay prayers beyond their proper time.
NAHHAS:v5p295/r12.anchor: وفي غير رواية طلحة بن مصرف أن سعدا قال سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون

NAHHAS:v5p295/r13.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p295/r13.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p295/r13.claim: The author prefers the timing explanation for its authority and sound Arabic over Abū al-ʿĀliyah's distracted-prayer interpretation.
NAHHAS:v5p295/r13.anchor: قال أبو جعفر وأولى من هذا القول لعلو من قال به ولصحته في العربية

QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r13.speaker: الضحاك عن ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r13.claim: Al-Dahhak transmits Ibn Abbas’s view that the heedless worshipper expects no reward for prayer and fears no punishment for abandoning it.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r13.anchor: فروى الضحاك عن ابن عباس قال: هو المصلي الذي إن صلى لم يرج لها ثوابا

QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r14.claim: Another report from Ibn Abbas identifies heedlessness as delaying prayers beyond their appointed times.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r14.anchor: وعنه أيضا: الذين يؤخرونها عن أوقاتها

QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r15.speaker: إبراهيم
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r15.claim: Ibrahim says the phrase means wasting prayer time; Abu al-ʿAliya adds failing to pray on time or complete bowing and prostration.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:1-5/r15.anchor: وكذا روى المغيرة عن إبراهيم، قال: ساهون بإضاعة الوقت

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r1.claim: The neglected prayer is linked to the later generation that squandered prayer at 19:59.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r1.anchor: فخلف من بعدهم خلف أضاعوا الصلاة

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r2.speaker: إبراهيم
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r2.claim: Ibrahim also says the heedless person turns his head while rising from prostration.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r2.anchor: وروي عن إبراهيم أيضا: أنه الذي إذا سجد قام برأسه هكذا ملتفتا

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r3.speaker: قطرب
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r3.claim: Qutrub defines heedlessness as failing to recite or remember God.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r3.anchor: وقال قطرب: هو ألا يقرأ ولا يذكر الله

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r4.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿud’s reading has لاهون, “distracted,” instead of the common ساهون.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r4.anchor: وفي قراءة عبد الله «الذين هم عن صلاتهم لاهون»

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r5.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r5.claim: Saʿd ibn Abi Waqqas transmits the Prophet’s explanation that they negligently postpone prayer beyond its time.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r5.anchor: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في قوله: { فويل للمصلين

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas says the verses describe hypocrites who leave prayer privately but perform it publicly, matching 4:142; Malik reports the same interpretation.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r6.anchor: وعن ابن عباس أيضا: هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة سرا

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas says that had the verse said “in their prayer,” it would have referred to believers’ involuntary distraction rather than neglect of prayer.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r7.anchor: ولو قال في صلاتهم ساهون لكانت في المؤمنين

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r8.speaker: عطاء
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r8.claim: ʿAta praises the wording عن صلاتهم because it says they neglect prayer itself, not that distraction happens within prayer.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r8.anchor: وقال عطاء: الحمد لله الذي قال: «عن صلاتهم» ولم يقل في صلاتهم

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r9.speaker: الزمخشري
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r9.claim: Al-Zamakhshari distinguishes neglecting prayer (عن) from distraction during prayer (في), which may happen to any Muslim through Satan or inner thoughts.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r9.anchor: معنى «عن» أنهم ساهون عنها سهو ترك لها وقلة التفات إليها

QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r10.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r10.claim: Ibn al-ʿArabi says freedom from in-prayer forgetfulness is impossible; someone who never lapses may not ponder the prayer, while the Prophet could be distracted by weightier matters.
QURTUBI-FULL:107:4-6/r10.anchor: لأن السلامة من السهو محال، وقد سها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في صلاته

QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r2.claim: Although Qutb leans toward a wholly Medinan setting because hypocrisy and ostentation were unfamiliar in Mecca, he allows later verses to have been appended for thematic continuity.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r2.anchor: وإن كانت السورة كلها وحدة متماسكة

QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r3.claim: The seven short verses overturn conventional ideas of faith and disbelief and reveal the creed’s mercy and immense good for humanity.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r3.anchor: إن هذه السورة الصغيرة ذات الآيات السبع القصيرة تعالج حقيقة ضخمة تكاد تبدل المفهوم السائد للإيمان والكفر

QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r5.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r5.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r5.claim: Religion is an integrated way of life whose worship, rites, and personal and social duties purify hearts and lead people to cooperation, care, and flourishing.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:1/r5.anchor: إنما هو منهج متكامل ، تتعاون عباداته وشعائره

QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r1.claim: The warning of ruin applies to people who are heedless of their prayer.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r1.anchor: إنه دعاء أو وعيد بالهلاك للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون

QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r2.claim: Those heedless worshippers are the ones who show off and withhold small acts of help.

QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r3.claim: They perform prayer but fail to establish it.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:4/r3.anchor: إنهم أولئك الذين يصلون ، ولكنهم لا يقيمون الصلاة

QUTB-ZILAL:107:5/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:5/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:5/r1.claim: They carry out prayer’s movements and recite its supplications, but their hearts and spirits do not experience its recitations, prayers, or glorifications.

QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r1.claim: They pray for people’s approval instead of sincerely for God, so they remain heedless of the prayer they are performing.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r1.anchor: إنهم يصلون رياء للناس لا إخلاصا لله

QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r2.claim: The required act is establishing prayer, which requires conscious presence and standing before God alone.
QUTB-ZILAL:107:6/r2.anchor: وإقامتها لا تكون إلا باستحضار حقيقتها

RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r1.claim: One link is that mistreating the orphan and withholding help show hypocrisy, while prayer without humility is an even clearer sign because it concerns service to the Creator.
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r1.anchor: معاملة مع المخلوق ، أما الصلاة فإنها خدمة للخالق

RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r2.claim: Another link answers the objection that prayer restrains indecency: this prayer cannot restrain evil when it consists of ostentation and inattention.
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r2.anchor: الصلاة كيف تنهاه عن هذا الفعل المنكر

RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r3.claim: A third link says orphan abuse neglects compassion for God’s creatures, and heedlessness in prayer neglects reverence for God; failing in both completes wretchedness.
RAZI-FULL:v32p106#2/r3.anchor: وسهوه في الصلاة تقصير فيما يرجع إلى التعظيم

RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r1.claim: The threat covers three sins: heedlessness about prayer, ostentation, and withholding small aid; since these do not alone make a Muslim hypocrite, commentators explain why the warning is so severe.

RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r2.claim: The preferred answer limits the description to hypocritical worshippers: their extra punishment for forbidden acts and omitted duties supports al-Shafi‘i’s view that unbelievers are addressed by the subsidiary laws.

RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r3.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r3.claim: If the verse said inattentive in their prayer, believers would be threatened; inattentent from their prayer means someone who forgets prayer and is wholly disengaged from it.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r3.anchor: ما رواه عطاء عن ابن عباس

RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r4.claim: Razi rejects interpreting heedlessness from prayer simply as abandoning it: the text still calls them worshippers, and abandonment alone is neither hypocrisy nor unbelief.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r4.anchor: وهذا القول ضعيف لأن السهو عن الصلاة لا يجوز أن يكون مفسرا بترك الصلاة

RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r5.claim: A reply is that they count as Muslims outwardly but forget prayer in reality, as hypocrites do; total forgetfulness of God’s remembrance throughout prayer marks a hypocrite, while a believer may be inattentive during some parts.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r5.anchor: إن المنافقين يخادعون الله وهو خادعهم وإذا قاموا إلى الصلواة قاموا كسالى

RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r6.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص ومسروق والحسن ومقاتل
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r6.claim: They interpret heedlessness as failure to maintain prayer times and conditions, not caring whether one prays.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107/r6.anchor: وهو قول سعد بن أبي وقاص ومسروق والحسن ومقاتل

RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r1.claim: Many scholars say the Prophet did not forget in prayer; God instead allowed him to perform a forgetful person’s action so the law would be demonstrated more clearly by practice.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r1.anchor: فقال كثير من العلماء : إنه عليه الصلاة والسلام ما سها

RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r2.claim: If prophetic or Companion forgetfulness occurred, it was repaired by prostration of forgetfulness, sunnah, or voluntary prayer; inner distraction is another category, while leaving prayer past its time without making it up is hypocritical mockery and worse than simply leaving it.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#2/r2.anchor: سهو الرسول والصحابة وذلك منجبر تارة بسجود السهو

RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r1.claim: A hypocrite displays faith while concealing unbelief; a show-off displays extra humility absent from the heart to seem devout, or differs from a hypocrite because his public prayer is better than his private prayer.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r1.anchor: أن المنافق هو المظهر للإيمان المبطن للكفر ، والمرائي المظهر

RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r7.claim: Heedlessness from prayer indicates both praying outside its time and being distracted within it; with ostentation added, prayer must be free from all three conditions.
RAZI-FULL:v32p107#3/r7.anchor: إخراجها عن الوقت ، وكون الإنسان غافلا فيها

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r1.claim: The commentary points readers to earlier discussions for the possible meanings of wayl.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r1.anchor: For the possible meanings of woe

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r2.claim: The verses may refer to disbelievers' prayer at the House, elsewhere described as whistling and clapping.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r2.anchor: These verses could be seen as a reference to the prayer of the disbelievers

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r3.speaker: majority of commentators
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r3.claim: The heedless gain no benefit from prayers they perform and fear no retribution when they omit them.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r3.anchor: the majority of commentators interpret them as a reference to those who, because of their heedlessness, receive no benefit from their prayers

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r4.speaker: majority of commentators
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r4.claim: Alternatively, the warning targets hypocrites who pray in public but not in private.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r4.anchor: or to the hypocrites, who pray in public, but not in private

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r5.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r5.claim: The warning can target those who miss prayer times or fail to complete the required bows and prostrations.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r5.anchor: those who fail to perform their prayers at the proper time or who do not complete the required bows and prostrations

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r6.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r6.claim: Another interpretation covers people who perform every prayer properly but lack humility, contemplation, and remembrance of God.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r6.anchor: those who perform all of the prayers properly, but fail to do so with humility, contemplation, and remembrance of God

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r7.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r7.claim: A hadith calls a delayed, hastily pecked prayer with little remembrance the prayer of a hypocrite.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r7.anchor: A ḥadīth states, “This is the prayer of the hypocrite. He sits watching the sun

STUDYQURAN:107:4/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r8.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r8.claim: The consequences of neglecting prayers are discussed at 19:59.
STUDYQURAN:107:4/r8.anchor: Regarding the implications of neglecting prayers, see 19:59c.

TAB:107:4/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r1.speaker: author
TAB:107:4/r1.claim: Al-Ṭabarī glosses the woe as a valley flowing with Hell's pus, for hypocrites who pray without seeking God and are heedless in prayer.
TAB:107:4/r1.anchor: فالوادي الذي يسيل من صديد أهل جهنم للمنافقين الذين يصلون ، لا يريدون الله عز وجل بصلاتهم

TAB:107:4/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r2.speaker: سعد
TAB:107:4/r2.claim: Saʿd says heedlessness means delaying prayer past its prescribed time, rather than leaving prayer altogether.
TAB:107:4/r2.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ، قال : قلت لأبي ، أرأيت قول الله عز وجل : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } : أيه تركها ؟ قال : لا ، ولكن تأخيرها عن وقتها .

TAB:107:4/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r3.speaker: سعد
TAB:107:4/r3.claim: Saʿd also distinguishes this from distracting thoughts during prayer: the condemned heedlessness is delaying prayer beyond its time.
TAB:107:4/r3.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ، قال : قلت لسعد : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } : أهو ما يحدث به أحدنا نفسه في صلاته ؟

TAB:107:4/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:107:4/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās interprets the phrase as delaying prayer beyond its appointed time.
TAB:107:4/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس ، في قوله : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : الذين يؤخرونها عن وقتها .

TAB:107:4/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r5.speaker: ابن أبزى
TAB:107:4/r5.claim: Ibn Abzāʾ says they delay the obligatory prayer until its time has passed.
TAB:107:4/r5.anchor: عن ابن أبزى : { فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : الذين يؤخرون الصلاة المكتوبة ، حتى تخرج من الوقت

TAB:107:4/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r6.speaker: مسروق
TAB:107:4/r6.claim: Masrūq explains the phrase as leaving prayer until its appointed time has passed.
TAB:107:4/r6.anchor: عن مسروق { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : الترك لوقتها .

TAB:107:4/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r7.speaker: مسلم بن صبيح
TAB:107:4/r7.claim: Muslim ibn Ṣubayḥ says they neglect prayer past its appointed time.
TAB:107:4/r7.anchor: عن مسلم بن صبيح { عن صلاتهم ساهون } الذين يضيعونها عن وقتها

TAB:107:4/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:107:4/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says these are hypocrites who display prayer before people, abandon it when unseen, and withhold borrowed household goods.
TAB:107:4/r8.anchor: عن ابن عباس ، في قوله : { فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } فهم المنافقون كانوا يراؤون الناس بصلاتهم إذا حضروا

TAB:107:4/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:107:4/r9.claim: A second report from Ibn ʿAbbās likewise says hypocrites leave prayer in private but perform it publicly.
TAB:107:4/r9.anchor: عن ابن عباس : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة في السر

TAB:107:4/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r10.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:4/r10.claim: Mujāhid gives another interpretation: they abandon the prayer.
TAB:107:4/r10.anchor: عن مجاهد { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : الترك لها

TAB:107:4/r11.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r11.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:4/r11.claim: Mujāhid also describes them as idle and inattentive toward their prayer.
TAB:107:4/r11.anchor: عن مجاهد ، قوله : { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : لاهون

TAB:107:4/r12.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r12.speaker: قتادة
TAB:107:4/r12.claim: Qatāda glosses them as heedless of prayer.
TAB:107:4/r12.anchor: عن قتادة { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } : غافلون

TAB:107:4/r13.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r13.speaker: قتادة
TAB:107:4/r13.claim: Qatāda explains that they are so careless that they do not mind whether they pray or not.
TAB:107:4/r13.anchor: عن قتادة { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : ساه عنها ، لا يبالي صلى أم لم يصل

TAB:107:4/r14.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r14.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB:107:4/r14.claim: Ibn Zayd says they pray, but prayer is not part of their real concern.
TAB:107:4/r14.anchor: قال ابن زيد ، في قوله : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم } ساهون يصلون ، وليست الصلاة من شأنهم

TAB:107:4/r15.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r15.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:4/r15.claim: Mujāhid says they take the prayer lightly.
TAB:107:4/r15.anchor: عن مجاهد ، في قوله : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : يتهاونون

TAB:107:4/r16.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r16.speaker: author
TAB:107:4/r16.claim: Al-Ṭabarī prefers heedlessness and distraction from prayer; this can lead both to abandoning prayer and to missing its time, so both reported explanations apply.
TAB:107:4/r16.anchor: وأولى الأقوال في ذلك عندي بالصواب بقوله : ساهون : لاهون يتغافلون عنها ، وفي اللهو عنها والتشاغل بغيرها ، تضييعها أحيانا ، وتضييع وقتها أخرى

TAB:107:4/r17.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r17.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB:107:4/r17.claim: A report from Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ says the Prophet identified them as people who delay prayer past its time; al-Ṭabarī cites it in support.
TAB:107:4/r17.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ، عن سعد بن أبي وقاص ، قال : سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، عن { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : «هم الذين يؤخرون الصلاة

TAB:107:4/r18.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r18.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB:107:4/r18.claim: A report from Abū Barza says this warning is more valuable than the whole world: the heedless person neither hopes for good when praying nor fears God when leaving prayer.
TAB:107:4/r18.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، لما نزلت هذه الآية : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } : «الله أكبر هذه خير لكم

TAB:107:4/r19.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:4/r19.speaker: author
TAB:107:4/r19.claim: Al-Ṭabarī says both meanings in the two prophetic reports are compatible with heedlessness about prayer.
TAB:107:4/r19.anchor: وكلا المعنيين اللذين ذكرت في الخبرين اللذين روينا عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم محتمل عن معنى السهو عن الصلاة

SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r1.claim: Alladhina hum may be nominative, accusative, or genitive as an adjective, appositive, or explanatory substitute; the next relative can attach either to al-musallin or the first relative.
SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r1.anchor: الذين هم }: يجوز أن يكون مرفوع المحل، وأن يكون منصوبه، وأن يكون مجروره تابعا. نعتا أو بدلا أو بيانا

SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r2.claim: Yuraʾuna derives from yuraʾiyuna like yuqātiluna; the hypocrite displays his action while hoping people will praise him, so the reciprocal form is apt.
SAMIN-DURR:107:5/r2.anchor: يراؤون " أصله يرائيون كيقاتلون. ومعنى المراءاة، أن المرائي يري الناس عمله، وهم يرونه الثناء عليه

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
