TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r1.speaker: مصعب بن سعد عن أبيه
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r1.claim: Saʿd says the verse means delaying prayer beyond its appointed time, rather than abandoning it.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r1.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد، قال: قلت لأبي، أرأيت قول الله عز وجل: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] أهي تركها؟ قال: « لا،

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r2.speaker: سعد
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r2.claim: In another version, Saʿd says this is delay beyond the prayer time, not stray thoughts during prayer.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r2.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد، قال: قلت لسعد: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] أهو ما يحدث به أحدنا نفسه في صلاته؟ قال:

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r3.speaker: مصعب بن سعد
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r3.claim: He glosses heedlessness as leaving prayer until its time has passed.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r3.anchor: عن عاصم، عن مصعب بن سعد: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: " السهو: الترك عن الوقت "

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says these people delay their prayers beyond the appointed time.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس، في قوله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «الذين يؤخرونها عن وقتها»

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r5.speaker: ابن أبزى
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r5.claim: Ibn Abzāʾ says they delay obligatory prayer until its time has expired.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r5.anchor: عن ابن أبزى {فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «الذين يؤخرون الصلاة المكتوبة،

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r6.speaker: مسروق
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r6.claim: Masrūq explains it as abandoning prayer at its proper time.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r6.anchor: عن مسروق، {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «الترك لوقتها»

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r7.speaker: مسروق
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r7.claim: Another report from Masrūq describes it as neglecting the prayer's appointed time.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r7.anchor: عن مسلم، عن مسروق، في قوله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «تضييع ميقاتها»

TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r8.speaker: آخرون
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r8.claim: Another reported interpretation is that they abandon prayer altogether.
TAB-FULL:v24p659#2/r8.anchor: وقال آخرون: بل عني بذلك أنهم يتركونها فلا يصلونها

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies them as hypocrites who pray ostentatiously in public, abandon prayer in private, and withhold borrowed goods out of hatred.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس، في قوله: {فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] «فهم المنافقون كانوا يراءون الناس بصلاتهم إذا حضروا،

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r2.claim: Another report says the hypocrites leave prayer when alone and perform it in public.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة في السر، ويصلون في العلانية»

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r3.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r3.claim: Mujāhid glosses heedlessness as abandoning prayer.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r3.anchor: عن مجاهد، {عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «الترك لها»

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r4.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r4.claim: Mujāhid also glosses them as heedless or lazy about prayer.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r4.anchor: عن مجاهد، قوله: {عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «لاهون»

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r5.claim: Qatāda says they are heedless of prayer.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r5.anchor: عن قتادة، {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] «غافلون»

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r6.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r6.claim: In another wording, Qatāda says they neglect prayer and do not care whether they pray.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r6.anchor: عن قتادة، {عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «ساه عنها لا يبالي صلى أم لم يصل»

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r7.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r7.claim: Ibn Zayd says they pray, but prayer is not a genuine concern of theirs.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r7.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] «يصلون، وليست الصلاة من شأنهم»

TAB-FULL:v24p662/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r8.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r8.claim: Al-Ṭabarī prefers heedless neglect or distraction: it entails sometimes abandoning prayer and sometimes missing its appointed time, accommodating both reported explanations.
TAB-FULL:v24p662/r8.anchor: وأولى الأقوال في ذلك عندي بالصواب بقوله: ساهون لاهون يتغافلون عنها؛

TAB-FULL:v24p664/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r1.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص عن النبي ﷺ
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r1.claim: The Prophet says those heedless of prayer delay it beyond its proper time.
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r1.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد، عن سعد بن أبي وقاص، قال: سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، عن {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال:

TAB-FULL:v24p664/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r2.speaker: أبو برزة الأسلمي عن النبي ﷺ
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r2.claim: A second report says their prayer earns no hope of good when performed and evokes no fear of God when omitted.
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r2.anchor: عن أبي برزة الأسلمي، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، لما نزلت هذه الآية: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5]

TAB-FULL:v24p664/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r3.claim: Al-Ṭabarī says both prophetic reports support plausible senses of being heedless about prayer.
TAB-FULL:v24p664/r3.anchor: وكلا المعنيين اللذين ذكرت في الخبرين اللذين روينا عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم محتمل عن معنى السهو عن الصلاة

TAB-FULL:v24p664#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p664#2/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v24p664#2/r2.claim: Mujāhid identifies those heedless in prayer as hypocrites.
TAB-FULL:v24p664#2/r2.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح، عن مجاهد: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [الماعون: 5] قال: «هم المنافقون»

TABRISI:107:4-5/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:107:4-5/r10.speaker: ابن عباس ومسروق
TABRISI:107:4-5/r10.claim: Ibn Abbas and Masrūq explain being heedless of prayer as delaying it beyond its proper time; the author says this was also reported as a Prophetic hadith.
TABRISI:107:4-5/r10.anchor: وهم الذين يؤخرون الصلاة عن أوقاتها عن ابن عباس ومسروق وروي ذلك مرفوعا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās through ʿAṭāʾ says the phrase is “heedless of their prayer,” not heedless while praying: hypocrites expect neither its reward nor punishment for abandoning it, and pray only around the Prophet.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r6.anchor: قال ابن عباس (في رواية عطاء) (6): لو كانت في صلاتهم ساهون، كانت في المؤمنين، ولكنها نزلت في المنافقين الذين لا يرجون لها ثوابا إن صلوا،

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r7.speaker: أكثر المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r7.claim: Most commentators say they neglect prayer until its time has passed; Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ, Muqatil, and al-Hasan state this explicitly.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r7.anchor: وقال أكثر المفسرين: معنى عنها ساهون أي يغفلوا (8) عنها حتى يذهب وقتها.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r8.speaker: قتادة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r8.claim: Qatāda says it is a person who does not care whether he prayed or not, which marks him as a hypocrite.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p357/r8.anchor: وقال قتادة: هو الذي لا يبالي (¬8) أصلى أم لم يصل (¬9)، ويدل على هذا أنه من صفة المنافقين.

WAHIDI-QT:107:4/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:107:4/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:107:4/r1.claim: The prayer's heedless practitioners delay it beyond its appointed time.
WAHIDI-QT:107:4/r1.anchor: { فويل للمصلين } { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } غافلون يؤخرونها عن وقتها

WAHIDI-QT:107:5/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:107:5/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:107:5/r1.claim: The prayer's heedless practitioners delay it beyond its appointed time.
WAHIDI-QT:107:5/r1.anchor: { فويل للمصلين } { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } غافلون يؤخرونها عن وقتها

ASAD-NOTES:107:1#n3/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:107:1#n3/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:107:1#n3/r1.claim: Asad specifies that the people are knowingly heedless of their prayers.
ASAD-NOTES:107:1#n3/r1.anchor: who are [knowingly] unmindful of their prayers

CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r1.claim: The root s-h-w here likely means the same as the later frequent term ghafla, religious heedlessness and negligence condemned also by Ephrem, according to Andrae; compare 51:11.
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r1.anchor: der u. a. bei Ephrem verurteilten religiösen Sorglosigkeit und Nachlässigkeit entspricht

CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r2.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r2.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r2.claim: For ṣallā and ṣalāh, the notes refer to the discussion under 108:2.
CORPUSCORANICUM:107:4-5:anmerkung/r2.anchor: Zu ṣallā und ṣalāh vgl. die Anmerkung zu 108:2

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#2/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#2/r1.claim: Qatāda says they neglect prayer and do not care whether they prayed.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p399#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله تعالى ﴿ الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾ قال ساه عنها لا يبالي

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r1.claim: Those heedless of prayer are unconcerned enough to miss it altogether or let its time expire, or they perform it unlike the Prophet and early Muslims, hurriedly and without reverence or attention.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r1.anchor: أي غافلون غير مبالين بها حتى تفوتهم بالكلية أو يخرج وقتها أو لا يصلونها كما صلاها رسول الله صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم والسلف ولكن ينقرونها نقرا ولا يخشعون

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r2.speaker: أبو العالية
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r2.claim: Abu al-Aliya explains heedlessness as turning one's gaze right and left.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r2.anchor: فعن أبي العالية هو الالتفات عن اليمينين واليسار

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r3.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r3.claim: Qatada says it is not caring whether one has prayed.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r3.anchor: وعن قتادة عدم مبالاة المرء أصلى أم لم يصلي

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas and a group identify it as delaying prayer beyond its appointed time.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r4.anchor: وعن ابن عباس وجماعة تأخيرها عن وقتها

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r5.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r5.claim: A report from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas raises this interpretation to the Prophet, but al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi judge its stopped Companion form sounder.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r5.anchor: عن سعد ابن أبي وقاص مرفوا وقال الحاكم والبيهقي وقفه أصح

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r6.claim: A second explanation from Abu al-Aliya is that a person does not know how many units he completed, even or odd.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r6.anchor: وعن أبي العالية هو أن لا يدري المرء عن كم انصرف عن شفع أم وتر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r7.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r7.claim: Some interpret heedlessness as abandoning prayer; on a total-abandonment reading the people named are those marked as worshippers, while occasional abandonment means the congregational worshippers.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p242#3/r7.anchor: وفسر بعضهم السهو عنها بتركها وقال المراد بالمصلين المتسمون بسمة أهل الصلاة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r8.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r8.claim: The threatened worshippers are heedless about their prayers, specifically neglecting their appointed times.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r8.anchor: {فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} [أي: عن مواقيتها غافلون]

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r9.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r9.claim: Asked who the heedless worshippers are, the Prophet explains that they let the prayer time lapse.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r9.anchor: سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن "الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون"، قال: "إضاعة الوقت"

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says they are hypocrites who omit prayer when unobserved but pray publicly when people are present, as in the description of those who show off.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p549#2/r10.anchor: قال ابن عباس: هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة إذا غابوا عن الناس، ويصلونها في العلانية

BAYDAWI-FULL:107:1-5/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:1-5/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:1-5/r6.claim: Woe is for worshippers who are inattentive to their prayers, heedless and unconcerned about them.
BAYDAWI-FULL:107:1-5/r6.anchor: ساهون } أي غافلون غير مبالين بها

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r2.claim: Sahw means forgetfulness and heedlessness; the Qur'an uses it only in al-Dhāriyāt and this verse.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r2.anchor: والسهو لغة: النسيان والغفلة. ولم يستعمله القرآن الكريم إلا في آيتين:

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r3.claim: The verse warns of heedlessness about prayer, not forgetfulness during prayer.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r3.anchor: وآية الماعون، والسهو فيها عن الصلاة، وليس في الصلاة.

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r4.claim: The author first rejects the interpretation as mistakes during prayer: such slips are neither sin nor wrongdoing, can happen to any believer, and are repaired by prostration of forgetfulness and extra prayers according to law.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r4.anchor: ومن ثم نستبعد ابتداء قول من تأولوا السهو في الآية بأنه سهو في الصلاة وليس السهو فيها بخطيئة ولا منكر، وكل مؤمن عرضه لأن يسهو في صلاته،

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r5.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r5.claim: Al-Tabari reports one interpretation as delaying prayer until its allotted time has passed.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r5.anchor: أنه تأخير الصلاة، لا يصلونها إلا بعد خروجها عنه وقتها.

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r6.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r6.claim: Another interpretation is abandoning prayer without intending to make it up.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r6.anchor: أنه الترك للصلاة لا على نية القضاء

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r7.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies them as hypocrites who pray ostentatiously when seen and leave prayer when unobserved.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r7.anchor: وعن ابن عباس: هم المنافقون كانوا يراءون بصلاتهم إذا حضروا ويتركونها إذا غابوا.

BINTSHATI:v2p188/r8.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r8.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r8.claim: Al-Tabari prefers that they are heedless and distracted about prayer, careless whether they pray at all.
BINTSHATI:v2p188/r8.anchor: وأولى الأقوال عند الطبري بالصواب: "أنهم ساهون لا هون يتغافلون عنها.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p541/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541/r1.claim: Al-Māʿūn is also called al-Dīn, Araʾayta and al-Takdhīb; its central warning is that denial of resurrection and recompense is the root of vices and contempt for sacred matters.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p541/r1.anchor: مقصودها التنبيه على أن التكذيب بالبعث لأجل الجزاء أبو الخبائث ، فإنه يجزئ المكذب

BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r1.claim: Harshness to orphans, failure to encourage feeding the poor, neglect of prayer, ostentation and withholding help all mark denial of judgment; belief instead produces praised conduct, so believers must avoid these traits.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r1.anchor: إن هذه كلها من شأن المكذب بالحساب والجزاء لأن نفع البعد عنها إنما يكون إذ ذاك

BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r3.claim: Neglecting prayers grows from the same distraction by wealth and children condemned in the surah of rivalry for more.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p542/r3.anchor: والسهو عن الصلوات من ثمرات إلهاء التكاثر , والشغل بالأموال والأولاد

BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r4.claim: A description rather than a verb ties the threat to a persistent trait; the intended targets are accountable people liable to prayer, not simply anyone presently performing it.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r4.anchor: علم أن المقصود إنما هو من كان مكلفا بالصلاة لأن من كان متلبسا بها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r6.claim: 'About their prayer' rather than 'in their prayer' describes entrenched heedlessness, neglect and indifference toward an obligation meant to benefit and purify them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r6.anchor: ولما كان المراد تضييعهم قال : { عن } دون في { صلاتهم } أي هي جديرة بأن تضاف إليهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r7.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r7.claim: Ibn Masʿūd is said to have read the word as lāhūn, meaning distracted, clarifying the heedlessness meant here.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r7.anchor: ويوضح ذلك أن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قرأ ( لاهون )

BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r8.claim: When asked about the verse, the Prophet explained that it means wasting the prayer's time.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r8.anchor: روى البغوي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل عن الآية فقال : ( هو إضاعة الوقت )

BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r9.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the hypocrites abandon prayer when alone but perform it in people's presence.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r9.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أنه قال : هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة إذا غابوا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r10.claim: Their neglect means abandoning prayer privately and corrupting its inward quality in public; ostentation makes them perform deeds to win praise or kindness, not hope for reward or fear of God's punishment, so they leave prayer when unseen.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p543/r10.anchor: تضييعها عند الانفراد بالترك حسا ومعنى وعند الاجتماع بالإفساد في المعنى : { الذين هم }

BIQAI-FULL:v8p548/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p548/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p548/r8.claim: The commands answer al-Māʿūn's four vices: giving counters stinginess, prayer counters neglect, exclusive devotion counters ostentation, and sacrifice counters withholding alms.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p548/r8.anchor: وقد قابل في هذا أربعا من سورة الدين بأربع , وهي البخل بالإعطاء , وإضاعة الصلاة بالأمر بها

DURR-FULL:v8p641/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r9.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the inattentive worshippers as hypocrites: they pray ostentatiously in public, abandon prayer in private, and withhold loaned household items; this is al-maʿun.
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r9.anchor: عن ابن عباس {فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: هم المنافقون يراؤون الناس بصلاتهم إذا حضروا

DURR-FULL:v8p641/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r10.claim: In another report, Ibn Abbas says hypocrites leave prayer in private but pray in public.
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r10.anchor: عن ابن عباس {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة في السر ويصلون في العلانية

DURR-FULL:v8p641/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r11.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r11.claim: Mujahid also identifies them as hypocrites.
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r11.anchor: عن مجاهد {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: هم المنافقون

DURR-FULL:v8p641/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r12.speaker: مصعب بن سعد
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r12.claim: When Musʿab asks his father Saʿd whether anyone avoids distraction in prayer, Saʿd explains that the verse means wasting prayer’s appointed time.
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r12.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد قال: قلت لأبي: أرأيت قول الله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} أينا لا يسهو

DURR-FULL:v8p641/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r13.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r13.claim: The Prophet is reported to explain the inattentive as people who delay prayer past its proper time; al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi say the report ascribed to Saʿd is more authentic.
DURR-FULL:v8p641/r13.anchor: عن سعد بن أبي وقاص قال: سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن قوله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: هم الذين يؤخرون الصلاة عن وقتها

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r1.speaker: رسول الله
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r1.claim: A weak-chain report from Abu Barza says the Prophet called this warning better than the whole world: the negligent pray without hope in their prayer and abandon it without fearing their Lord.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r1.anchor: بسند ضعيف عن أبي برزة الأسلمي قال: لما نزلت هذه الآية {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: الله أكبر

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the negligent delay prayer beyond its time.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: الذين يؤخرونها عن وقتها

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r3.speaker: مسروق
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r3.claim: Masruq glosses the phrase as neglecting the prayer’s appointed time.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r3.anchor: عن مسروق {عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: تضييع ميقاتها

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r4.speaker: أبو العالية
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r4.claim: Abu al-Aliya first defines inattentiveness as uncertainty about how many units one completed, odd or even; al-Hasan corrects him that it means missing the prayer time until it passes.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r4.anchor: فقال أبو العالية: هو الذي لا يدري عن كم انصرف عن شفع أو عن وتر فقال الحسن: مه هو الذي يسهو عن ميقاتها حتى تفوت

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r5.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r5.claim: Mujahid glosses the phrase as heedlessness.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: لاهون

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r6.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r6.claim: Ibn Masʿud is reported to read “those who are heedless of their prayer” as “those who are distracted from it.”
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r6.anchor: عن ابن مسعود أنه قرأ: الذين هم عن صلاتهم لاهون

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r7.speaker: عطاء بن يسار
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r7.claim: ʿAta ibn Yasar observes that the wording says they are inattentive about prayer, not inattentive within it.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r7.anchor: عن عطاء بن يسار قال: الحمد لله الذي قال {هم عن صلاتهم ساهون} ولم يقل في صلاتهم

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r8.speaker: أبو العالية
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r8.claim: Abu al-Aliya says the inattentive person turns right and left while praying.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r8.anchor: عن أبي العالية {عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: هو الذي يصلي ويقول: هكذا وهكذا

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r9.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r9.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says they pray for show and prayer is not truly their concern.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r9.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم {عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: يصلون رياء وليس الصلاة من شأنهم

DURR-FULL:v8p642/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r10.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r10.claim: Qatada says they do not care whether they pray or leave prayer undone.
DURR-FULL:v8p642/r10.anchor: عن قتادة {عن صلاتهم ساهون} قال: لا يبالي عنها أصلى أم لم يصل

TAB:107:5/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r1.speaker: author
TAB:107:5/r1.claim: Al-Ṭabarī explains woe as a valley of Hell’s pus for hypocrites who pray without intending God and are heedless while praying.
TAB:107:5/r1.anchor: يقول تعالى ذكره :  فالوادي الذي يسيل من صديد أهل جهنم للمنافقين الذين يصلون ،

TAB:107:5/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r2.speaker: مصعب بن سعد
TAB:107:5/r2.claim: Musʿab recounts asking his father whether the phrase meant abandoning prayer; his father says no, it means delaying prayer beyond its time.
TAB:107:5/r2.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ،   قال :  قلت لأبي ،   أرأيت قول الله عزّ وجلّ

TAB:107:5/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r3.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
TAB:107:5/r3.claim: Asked whether ordinary thoughts during prayer are meant, Saʿd says the intended heedlessness is delaying prayer past its time.
TAB:107:5/r3.anchor: قلت لسعد :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } :  أهو ما يحدّث به أحدنا نفسه في صلاته ؟  قال :  لا ،   ولكن السهو أن يؤخّرها عن وقتها .

TAB:107:5/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r4.speaker: مصعب بن سعد
TAB:107:5/r4.claim: Musʿab glosses heedlessness as leaving prayer until its proper time has passed.
TAB:107:5/r4.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  السهو :  الترك عن الوقت .

TAB:107:5/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:107:5/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says they delay prayers beyond their appointed times.
TAB:107:5/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس ،   في قوله :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  الّذِينَ يؤخّرونها عن وقتها .

TAB:107:5/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r6.speaker: ابن أبزى
TAB:107:5/r6.claim: Ibn Abzāʾ says they postpone the obligatory prayer until its time has expired.
TAB:107:5/r6.anchor: عن ابن أبزى :  {  فَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُصَلّينَ الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  الذين يُؤّخرون الصلاة المكتوبة

TAB:107:5/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r7.speaker: مسروق
TAB:107:5/r7.claim: Masrūq explains the phrase as abandoning prayer at its proper time.
TAB:107:5/r7.anchor: عن مسروق {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  الترك لوقتها .

TAB:107:5/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r8.speaker: مسروق
TAB:107:5/r8.claim: Masrūq also describes it as neglecting the prayer’s appointed time.
TAB:107:5/r8.anchor: عن مسلم ،   عن مسروق ،   في قوله :  {  الّذِينَ هُم عَنْ صْلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  تضييع مِيقاتها .

TAB:107:5/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r9.speaker: أبو الضحى
TAB:107:5/r9.claim: Abū al-Ḍuḥā says they leave the obligatory prayer until its proper time.
TAB:107:5/r9.anchor: عن الأعمش ،   عن أبي الضحى {  عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  ترك المكتوبة لوقتها .

TAB:107:5/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r10.speaker: مسلم بن صبيح
TAB:107:5/r10.claim: Muslim ibn Ṣubayḥ describes them as neglecting prayer beyond its appointed time.
TAB:107:5/r10.anchor: عن الأعمش ،   عن مسلم بن صبيح {  عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } الذين يضيعونها عن وقتها .

TAB:107:5/r11.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r11.speaker: آخرون
TAB:107:5/r11.claim: Another reported view interprets the phrase as abandoning prayer and not performing it.
TAB:107:5/r11.anchor: وقال آخرون :  بل عُني بذلك أنهم يتركونها فلا يصلونها .   ذكر من قال ذلك :

TAB:107:5/r12.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r12.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:107:5/r12.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies hypocrites who pray ostentatiously when present, abandon prayer when absent, and withhold borrowed goods out of hostility; he links this to al-māʿūn.
TAB:107:5/r12.anchor: عن ابن عباس ،   في قوله :  {  فَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُصَلّينَ الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } فهم المنافقون كانوا يراؤون الناس بصلاتهم إذا حضروا ،   ويتركونها إذا غابوا

TAB:107:5/r13.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r13.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:107:5/r13.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the hypocrites leave prayer in private but perform it publicly.
TAB:107:5/r13.anchor: عن ابن عباس :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة في السرّ ،   ويصلون في العلانية .

TAB:107:5/r14.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r14.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:5/r14.claim: Mujāhid gives the concise gloss: abandoning prayer.
TAB:107:5/r14.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح ،   عن مجاهد {  عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  الترك لها .

TAB:107:5/r15.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r15.speaker: آخرون
TAB:107:5/r15.claim: A further reported view takes heedlessness as neglect, inattention, and playfulness toward prayer.
TAB:107:5/r15.anchor: وقال آخرون :  بل عُني بذلك أنهم يتهاونون بها ،   ويتغافلون عنها ويَلْهُونَ .   ذكر من قال ذلك :

TAB:107:5/r16.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r16.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:5/r16.claim: Mujāhid describes them as distracted and heedless of prayer.
TAB:107:5/r16.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح ،   عن مجاهد ،   قوله :  {  عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  لاهون .

TAB:107:5/r17.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r17.speaker: قتادة
TAB:107:5/r17.claim: Qatāda glosses them as inattentive to prayer.
TAB:107:5/r17.anchor: عن قتادة {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } :  غافلون .

TAB:107:5/r18.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r18.speaker: قتادة
TAB:107:5/r18.claim: Qatāda further says they do not care whether they pray or leave prayer undone.
TAB:107:5/r18.anchor: عن قتادة {  عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  ساهٍ عنها ،   لا يبالي صلّى أم لم يصلّ .

TAB:107:5/r19.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r19.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB:107:5/r19.claim: Ibn Zayd says they do pray, but prayer is not characteristic of their lives.
TAB:107:5/r19.anchor: قال ابن زيد ،   في قوله :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ } ساهُونَ يصلون ،   وليست الصلاة من شأنهم .

TAB:107:5/r20.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r20.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:5/r20.claim: Mujāhid also describes them as treating prayer carelessly.
TAB:107:5/r20.anchor: عن مجاهد ،   في قوله :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  يتهاونون .

TAB:107:5/r21.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r21.speaker: author
TAB:107:5/r21.claim: Al-Ṭabarī prefers heedlessness as being distracted from prayer: such distraction leads sometimes to abandoning prayer and sometimes to missing its time, reconciling both earlier views.
TAB:107:5/r21.anchor: وأولى الأقوال في ذلك عندي بالصواب بقوله :  ساهُونَ :  لاهون يتغافلون عنها ،   وفي اللهو عنها والتشاغل بغيرها ،

TAB:107:5/r22.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r22.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن سعد بن أبي وقاص
TAB:107:5/r22.claim: In a report from Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ, the Prophet identifies them as those who delay prayer beyond its appointed time.
TAB:107:5/r22.anchor: عن سعد بن أبي وقاص ،   قال :  سألت النبيّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ،   عن {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  «هم الذين يؤخّرون الصلاة عن وقتها » .

TAB:107:5/r23.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r23.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن أبي برزة الأسلمي
TAB:107:5/r23.claim: A report from Abū Barza al-Aslamī says the verse is better for the hearers than receiving the whole world; the heedless person neither hopes for good from prayer nor fears God if leaving it.
TAB:107:5/r23.anchor: عن أبي بَرْزة الأسلميّ ،   قال :  قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ،   لما نزلت هذه الاَية :

TAB:107:5/r24.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r24.speaker: عطاء بن دينار
TAB:107:5/r24.claim: ʿAṭāʾ ibn Dīnār praises God for stating that some are heedless of their prayer.
TAB:107:5/r24.anchor: عن عطاء بن دينار أنه قال :  الحمد لله الذي قال :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } .

TAB:107:5/r25.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:5/r25.speaker: author
TAB:107:5/r25.claim: Al-Ṭabarī concludes that both senses conveyed by the two prophetic reports can apply to heedlessness of prayer.
TAB:107:5/r25.anchor: وكلا المعنيين اللذين ذكرت في الخبرين اللذين روينا عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم محتمل عن معنى السهو عن الصلاة .

TAB:107:6/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:6/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB:107:6/r2.claim: Mujāhid identifies those heedless of prayer as hypocrites.
TAB:107:6/r2.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح ،   عن مجاهد :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ } قال :  هم المنافقون .

TAB:107:6/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:107:6/r4.speaker: الضحاك
TAB:107:6/r4.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says the heedless worshippers and those who show off are hypocrites.
TAB:107:6/r4.anchor: سمعت الضحاك يقول في قوله :  {  الّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ الّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَاءُونَ } يعني المنافقين .

BURHAN:v1p293/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p293/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
BURHAN:v1p293/r6.claim: Abu al-Aliya took the heedless worshippers to be people who leave prayer unsure whether they prayed an even or odd number of units.
BURHAN:v1p293/r6.anchor: فروى الخطابى عن أبى العالية أنه سئل عن معنى قوله

BURHAN:v1p293/r7.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p293/r7.speaker: الحسن
BURHAN:v1p293/r7.claim: Hasan rejects Abu al-Aliya’s reading: عن signals neglecting prayer until its appointed time passes; being distracted during prayer would take في.
BURHAN:v1p293/r7.anchor: قال الحسن مه يا أبا العالية ليس هكذا بل الذين سهوا عن ميقاتهم حتى تفوتهم

BURHAN:v2p104/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p104/r2.speaker: أبو العالية
BURHAN:v2p104/r2.claim: Abu al-Aliya again reads the heedless as someone who leaves prayer unsure whether the number prayed was even or odd.
BURHAN:v2p104/r2.anchor: ولهذا قال أبو العالية فى قوله تعالى

BURHAN:v2p104/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p104/r3.speaker: الحسن
BURHAN:v2p104/r3.claim: Hasan’s preferred reading depends on the preposition: في would mean distraction during prayer, while عن means leaving prayer until its time has passed.
BURHAN:v2p104/r3.anchor: فرد عليه الحسن بأنه لو كان كذلك لقال

BURHAN:v4p176/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p176/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
BURHAN:v4p176/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās praises God for saying they are heedless of their prayer, rather than heedless within the prayer.
BURHAN:v4p176/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس الحمد الله الذي قال ﴿ عن صلاتهم ساهون ﴾

BURHAN:v1p202#2/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p202#2/r1.speaker: مقاتل بن سليمان
BURHAN:v1p202#2/r1.claim: Muqatil ibn Sulayman says Surat al-Maun is Meccan except from فويل للمصلين through its end, which is Medinan.
BURHAN:v1p202#2/r1.anchor: سورة ﴿ أرأيت ﴾ مكية إلا قوله ﴿ فويل للمصلين ﴾ إلى آخرها فإنها مدنية كذا قال مقاتل بن سليمان

ITQAN:v3p297/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p297/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p297/r2.claim: Al-Kawthar counters al-Ma'un's four traits: abundant giving opposes miserliness, prayer opposes neglect, worship for God opposes showing off, and sacrifice meat is charity opposing withholding small kindnesses.
ITQAN:v3p297/r2.anchor: لأن السابقة وصف الله فيها المنافق بأربعة أمور البخل وترك الصلاة والرياء فيها ومنع الزكاة

ITQAN:v4p537#4/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p537#4/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
ITQAN:v4p537#4/r1.claim: In response to Saad ibn Abi Waqqas, the Prophet said those heedless of prayer are people who delay it beyond its prescribed time.
ITQAN:v4p537#4/r1.anchor: عن سعد بن أبي وقاص قال سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن

KHATTABI:v1p31/r6.author: al-Khaṭṭābī
KHATTABI:v1p31/r6.speaker: أبو العالية؛ الحسن
KHATTABI:v1p31/r6.claim: Asked what heedlessness in prayer means, Abū al-ʿĀliya says losing track of whether one has prayed an even or odd number of units; al-Ḥasan rejects this and says it means letting the prayer time pass.
KHATTABI:v1p31/r6.anchor: قال رجل يا أبا العالية قول الله في كتابه: {فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون}

KHATTABI:v1p33/r1.author: al-Khaṭṭābī
KHATTABI:v1p33/r1.speaker: author
KHATTABI:v1p33/r1.claim: Al-Ḥasan’s reading is preferred: “ʿan ṣalātihim” means neglecting the appointed time; confusion over units happens during prayer and would be expressed with “fī ṣalātihim.”
KHATTABI:v1p33/r1.anchor: فلو كان هو المراد لقيل: في صلاتهم ساهون , فلما قال عن صلاتهم دل على أن المراد به الذهاب عن الوقت

KHATTABI:v1p33/r3.author: al-Khaṭṭābī
KHATTABI:v1p33/r3.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
KHATTABI:v1p33/r3.claim: In a report from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, the Prophet distinguishes freeing one enslaved person outright from contributing toward the purchase price to emancipate someone.
KHATTABI:v1p33/r3.anchor: عن البراء بن عازب أن أعرابيا جاء

KHATTABI:v1p33/r4.author: al-Khaṭṭābī
KHATTABI:v1p33/r4.speaker: الكسائي
KHATTABI:v1p33/r4.claim: Al-Kisāʾī permits two forms equating the hornet and scorpion with “iyyā”; al-Ḥasan’s gathered Bedouin authorities reject his usage, siding with Sībawayh.
KHATTABI:v1p33/r4.anchor: فألقى سيبويه على الكسائي مسألة فقال: هل يجوز قول القائل: كاد الزنبور يكون العقرب

KHATTABI:v1p33/r5.author: al-Khaṭṭābī
KHATTABI:v1p33/r5.speaker: سيبويه
KHATTABI:v1p33/r5.claim: Sībawayh’s analysis is preferred because “iyyā” is used only in the accusative, while the disputed expression requires a nominative form; the Bedouin judges confirm his view.
KHATTABI:v1p33/r5.anchor: قيل وذلك أن حرف (إيا) إنما يستعمل في موضع النصب , وهي هنا في موضع رفع فلم يجز.

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r1.claim: The preposition عن makes the warning concern heedlessness of prayer's purpose: standing before God, restraining wrongdoing, cultivating humility, and prompting care for orphans and the poor.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r1.anchor: فنرى النذير بالويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون غافلون عن كونها قياما بين يدي الخالق

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r2.claim: This is not forgetfulness during prayer, abandoning prayer or its time, or fidgeting and yawning; some pray on time and feign humility for an audience or benefit, turning prayer into ostentation and formal hypocrisy.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p203/r2.anchor: ليس السهو عن الصلاة إذن سهوا فيها ولا تركا لها أو ترك وقتها

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r2.claim: Bint al-Shati rejects interpreting sahūn as ordinary forgetfulness during prayer; the preposition ʿan points away from prayer rather than to a lapse within it.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r2.anchor: نستبعد قول من تأولوا السهو عن الصلاة في الآية، بأنه سهو في الصلاة

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r3.claim: Incidental forgetfulness in prayer is not a sin or wrong; it can be repaired by prostration for forgetfulness or by sunnah and voluntary prayers, which is why it cannot be the condemned lapse.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r3.anchor: فليس السهو فيها بخطيئة أو منكر، وكل مؤمن عرضة لأن يسهو في صلاته

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r4.speaker: الطبري
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r4.claim: Al-Tabari says the condemned are heedless of prayer, distracted from it, and thereby sometimes neglect prayer itself or its time; Bint al-Shati says she is not persuaded by this reading.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r4.anchor: ما ذهب إليه الإمام الطبري في قوله: "وأوْلى الأقوال عندي بالصواب، أنهم ساهون لاهون يتغافلون عنها

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī adds that they may pray unlike the Prophet and early Muslims, pecking through the prayer without humility or avoiding disliked acts.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p202/r5.anchor: ما أضافه الزمخشري: أو لا يصلونها كما صلاها رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - والسلف. ولكن ينقرونها نقرا

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r1.claim: Sahā ʿan something means to neglect or leave it through inattention.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r1.anchor: سها عن كذا يسهو سهوراً : لها عنه وتركه عن غفلة

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r2.claim: They fail to perform prayer as a Muslim does, with belief in its obligation and a desire to draw near to God.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r2.anchor: نظراً إلى أنهم لا يوقعونها ،   كما يوقعها المسلم من اعتقاد وجوبها والتقرب بها إلى الله تعالى

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r3.speaker: النبي
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r3.claim: A hadith glosses inattentiveness about prayer as delaying it beyond its time out of disregard.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r3.anchor: وفي الحديث عن صلاتهم ساهون : « يؤخرونها عن وقتها تهاوناً بها »

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r4.speaker: مجاهد
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r4.claim: Mujāhid explains the delay as abandonment and neglect.

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r5.speaker: إبراهيم
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r5.claim: Ibrāhīm describes someone who turns his head while prostrating.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r5.anchor: وقال إبراهيم : هو الذي إذا سجد قال برأسه هكذا ملتفتاً

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r6.speaker: قتادة
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r6.claim: Qatāda says they abandon prayer, or are indifferent to whether they pray at all.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r6.anchor: وقال قتادة : هو الترك لها ،   أو هم الغافلون الذين لا يبالي أحدهم أصلى أم لم يصل

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r7.speaker: قطرب
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r7.claim: Quṭrub describes someone who neither settles nor remembers God.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r7.anchor: وقال قطرب : هو الذي لا يقر ولا يذكر الله تعالى

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies hypocrites who omit prayer in private but perform it publicly, citing their lazy rising for prayer and their showing off.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r8.anchor: وقال ابن عباس : المنافقون يتركون الصلاة سراً ويفعلونها علانية ،   { وإذا قاموا إلى الصلاة قاموا كسالى }

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r9.speaker: مالك
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r9.claim: Mālik, as reported by Ibn Wahb, also identifies them as hypocrites, supported by the next verse’s description of show-offs.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r9.anchor: ويدل على أنها في المنافقين قوله تعالى : { الذين هم يراءون } ،   وقاله ابن وهب عن مالك

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says that “in their prayer” would have referred to believers, whereas “about their prayer” describes hypocrites.
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r10.anchor: قال ابن عباس : ولو قال في صلاتهم لكانت في المؤمنين

ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r11.speaker: عطاء
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r11.claim: ʿAṭāʾ praises God for saying “about their prayer” rather than “in their prayer.”
ABUHAYYAN:107:5/r11.anchor: وقال عطاء : الحمد لله الذي قال عن صلاتهم ولم يقل في صلاتهم

ALUSI:107:4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:107:4/r1.claim: The threat concerns worshippers indifferent to prayer: they may omit it altogether or let its time expire.
ALUSI:107:4/r1.anchor: أي غافلون غير مبالين بها حتى تفوتهم بالكلية أو يخرج وقتها

ALUSI:107:4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI:107:4/r2.claim: Others pray but peck at it without humility, wander among irrelevant thoughts, and finish unaware of what they recited, showing little concern.
ALUSI:107:4/r2.anchor: ولكن ينقرونها نقراً ولا يخشعون وينجدون فيها ويتهمون وفي كل واد من الأفكار الغير المناسبة لها يهيمون

ALUSI:107:4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r3.speaker: أبي العالية
ALUSI:107:4/r3.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya explains heedlessness as turning right and left.
ALUSI:107:4/r3.anchor: فعن أبي العالية هو الالتفات عن اليمين واليسار

ALUSI:107:4/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r4.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI:107:4/r4.claim: Qatāda explains it as not caring whether one prays or does not pray.
ALUSI:107:4/r4.anchor: وعن قتادة عدم مبالاة المرء أصلي أم لم يصل

ALUSI:107:4/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r5.speaker: ابن عباس وجماعة
ALUSI:107:4/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and a group say it means delaying prayer beyond its time; a report from Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ is attributed to the Prophet, but al-Ḥākim and al-Bayhaqī say the stopped-at-Companion version is sounder.
ALUSI:107:4/r5.anchor: وعن ابن عباس وجماعة تأخيرها عن وقتها وفيه حديث أخرجه غير واحد عن سعد بن أبي وقاص مرفوعاً

ALUSI:107:4/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r6.speaker: أبي العالية
ALUSI:107:4/r6.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya also explains heedlessness as not knowing whether one finished an even or odd number of prayer units.
ALUSI:107:4/r6.anchor: وعن أبي العالية هو أن لا يدري المرء عن كم انصرف عن شفع أو عن وتر

ALUSI:107:4/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:4/r7.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI:107:4/r7.claim: Some interpret heedlessness as abandoning prayer: the term worshippers then means people marked as praying if they abandon it entirely, or occasional worshippers if they abandon it at times.
ALUSI:107:4/r7.anchor: وفسر بعضهم السهو عنها بتركها وقال المراد بالمصلين المتسمون بسمة أهل الصلاة

ALUSI:107:5/r7.anchor: وفسر بعضهم السهو عنها بتركها وقال المراد بالمصلين المتسمون بسمة أهل الصلاة

ALUSI:107:7/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:7/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI:107:7/r11.claim: The fāʾ in fa-wayl is consequential: the discourse escalates from orphan-pushing to prayer-neglect, ostentation, and withholding zakāt or customary loans, increasingly exposing denial of religion.
ALUSI:107:7/r11.anchor: جزائية والكلام ترق من ذلك المعرف إلى معرف أقوى

ALUSI:107:7/r16.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:7/r16.speaker: صاحب الكشف
ALUSI:107:7/r16.claim: The Kashf author says that if the orphan-pusher is a named individual, treating the later prayer-neglect and ostentation as further identifying labels is ill-fitting; those clauses work as a digression prompted by the orphan-pushing description.
ALUSI:107:7/r16.anchor: قال «صاحب الكشف » غير ملائم بل يكون شبه استطراد

ALUSI:107:7/r17.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:7/r17.speaker: author
ALUSI:107:7/r17.claim: Al-Ālūsī says the sūra's main concern is denial of religion, using orphan-abuse as its identifying sign and the later vices to press the question whether such conduct is good or evil, like the rebuke in 5:91.
ALUSI:107:7/r17.anchor: فكأنه قيل أخبرني ما تقول فيمن يكذبون بالدين وفيمن يؤذون اليتيم

ALUSI:107:7/r18.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:7/r18.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI:107:7/r18.claim: Some make the fāʾ causal from the preceding coordination, requiring the worshippers and deniers to be one group; they are then identified as hypocrites, a reading reported from Ibn ʿAbbās, Mujāhid, and Mālik, and supported by the ostentation clause.
ALUSI:107:7/r18.anchor: وجعل بعضهم الفاء في فويل على العطف المذكور للسببية وهذا الوجه يقتضي اتحاد المصلين والمكذبين

ALUSI:107:7/r19.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:7/r19.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد والإمام مالك
ALUSI:107:7/r19.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, Mujāhid, and Imām Mālik are reported to identify the worshippers as hypocrites; al-Baḥr cites the ostentation description as evidence.
ALUSI:107:7/r19.anchor: بل روى إطلاق القول بأنهم المرادون عن ابن عباس ومجاهد والإمام مالك

ALUSI:107:7/r20.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:107:7/r20.speaker: قيل
ALUSI:107:7/r20.claim: On the unified-group reading, the worshippers could be all legally accountable people, even non-hypocrite disbelievers, and heedlessness could mean total abandonment of prayer, entailing that disbelievers are obligated by legal branches.
ALUSI:107:7/r20.anchor: ويصح أن يراد بالمصلين على الاتحاد المكلفون بالصلاة ولو كفاراً غير منافقين

BAGHAWI:107:4/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r1.speaker: سعد
BAGHAWI:107:4/r1.claim: Saʿd reports that the Prophet explained being heedless of prayer as wasting its appointed time; Baghawi gives no grading.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r1.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ، عن أبيه أنه قال :  "  سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : إضاعة الوقت

BAGHAWI:107:4/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI:107:4/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says these are hypocrites who omit prayer when away from people but pray publicly when seen, as the next verse says they show off.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس : هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة إذا غابوا عن الناس ، ويصلونها في العلانية إذا حضروا

BAGHAWI:107:4/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:107:4/r3.claim: Baghawi links Ibn Abbas’s description to the account of hypocrites who stand lazily in prayer to be seen by people.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r3.anchor: وقال في وصف المنافقين :{ وإذا قاموا إلى الصلاة قاموا كسالى يراؤون الناس }

BAGHAWI:107:4/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r4.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI:107:4/r4.claim: Qatada says they are inattentive to prayer and do not care whether they pray.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة : ساه عنها ، لا يبالي صلى أم لم يصل

BAGHAWI:107:4/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r5.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI:107:4/r5.claim: One view says they neither hope for reward if they pray nor fear punishment if they leave prayer.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r5.anchor: وقيل : لا يرجون لها ثواباً إن صلوا ، ولا يخافون عقاباً إن تركوا

BAGHAWI:107:4/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r6.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI:107:4/r6.claim: Mujahid says they are heedless of prayer and treat it negligently.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r6.anchor: وقال مجاهد : غافلون عنها يتهاونون بها

BAGHAWI:107:4/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r7.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI:107:4/r7.claim: Al-Hasan describes someone who prays only to show off and feels no regret when he misses prayer.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن : هو الذي إن صلاها صلاها رياءً ، وإن فاتته لم يندم

BAGHAWI:107:4/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:4/r8.speaker: أبو العالية
BAGHAWI:107:4/r8.claim: Abu al-ʿAliya says they do not pray at the appointed times or complete their bowing and prostration.
BAGHAWI:107:4/r8.anchor: وقال أبو العالية : لا يصلونها لمواقيتها ، ولا يتمون ركوعها وسجودها

BAGHAWI:107:5/r3.anchor: وقال في وصف المنافقين :{ وإذا قاموا إلى الصلاة قاموا كسالى يراؤون الناس }

BAGHAWI:107:5/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:5/r4.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI:107:5/r4.claim: Qatada says they are inattentive to prayer and do not care whether they pray.
BAGHAWI:107:5/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة : ساه عنها ، لا يبالي صلى أم لم يصل

BAGHAWI:107:5/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:5/r5.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI:107:5/r5.claim: One view says they neither hope for reward if they pray nor fear punishment if they leave prayer.
BAGHAWI:107:5/r5.anchor: وقيل : لا يرجون لها ثواباً إن صلوا ، ولا يخافون عقاباً إن تركوا

BAGHAWI:107:5/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:5/r6.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI:107:5/r6.claim: Mujahid says they are heedless of prayer and treat it negligently.
BAGHAWI:107:5/r6.anchor: وقال مجاهد : غافلون عنها يتهاونون بها

BAGHAWI:107:5/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:5/r7.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI:107:5/r7.claim: Al-Hasan describes someone who prays only to show off and feels no regret when he misses prayer.
BAGHAWI:107:5/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن : هو الذي إن صلاها صلاها رياءً ، وإن فاتته لم يندم

BAGHAWI:107:5/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:5/r8.speaker: أبو العالية
BAGHAWI:107:5/r8.claim: Abu al-ʿAliya says they do not pray at the appointed times or complete their bowing and prostration.
BAGHAWI:107:5/r8.anchor: وقال أبو العالية : لا يصلونها لمواقيتها ، ولا يتمون ركوعها وسجودها

BAGHAWI:107:6/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r1.speaker: سعد
BAGHAWI:107:6/r1.claim: Saʿd reports that the Prophet explained being heedless of prayer as wasting its appointed time; Baghawi gives no grading.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r1.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ، عن أبيه أنه قال :  "  سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : إضاعة الوقت

BAGHAWI:107:6/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI:107:6/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says these are hypocrites who omit prayer when away from people but pray publicly when seen, as the next verse says they show off.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس : هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة إذا غابوا عن الناس ، ويصلونها في العلانية إذا حضروا

BAGHAWI:107:6/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI:107:6/r3.claim: Baghawi links Ibn Abbas’s description to the account of hypocrites who stand lazily in prayer to be seen by people.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r3.anchor: وقال في وصف المنافقين :{ وإذا قاموا إلى الصلاة قاموا كسالى يراؤون الناس }

BAGHAWI:107:6/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r4.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI:107:6/r4.claim: Qatada says they are inattentive to prayer and do not care whether they pray.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة : ساه عنها ، لا يبالي صلى أم لم يصل

BAGHAWI:107:6/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r5.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI:107:6/r5.claim: One view says they neither hope for reward if they pray nor fear punishment if they leave prayer.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r5.anchor: وقيل : لا يرجون لها ثواباً إن صلوا ، ولا يخافون عقاباً إن تركوا

BAGHAWI:107:6/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r6.speaker: مجاهد
BAGHAWI:107:6/r6.claim: Mujahid says they are heedless of prayer and treat it negligently.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r6.anchor: وقال مجاهد : غافلون عنها يتهاونون بها

BAGHAWI:107:6/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r7.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI:107:6/r7.claim: Al-Hasan describes someone who prays only to show off and feels no regret when he misses prayer.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن : هو الذي إن صلاها صلاها رياءً ، وإن فاتته لم يندم

BAGHAWI:107:6/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI:107:6/r8.speaker: أبو العالية
BAGHAWI:107:6/r8.claim: Abu al-ʿAliya says they do not pray at the appointed times or complete their bowing and prostration.
BAGHAWI:107:6/r8.anchor: وقال أبو العالية : لا يصلونها لمواقيتها ، ولا يتمون ركوعها وسجودها

BAYDAWI:107:5/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:107:5/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:107:5/r1.claim: They are heedless of their prayer and do not care about it.

BAYDAWI:107:7/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:107:7/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:107:7/r3.claim: If disregard for the orphan shows weak religion, heedlessness of prayer, ostentation, and withholding zakāt deserve woe even more; prayer is religion’s pillar, ostentation a branch of unbelief, and zakāt its bridge.
BAYDAWI:107:7/r3.anchor: فالسهو عن الصلاة التي هي عماد الدين ، والرياء الذي هو شعبة من الكفر ، ومنع الزكاة التي هي قنطرة الإسلام ، أحق بذلك ، ولذلك رتب عليها الويل

BIQAI:107:5/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:107:5/r1.claim: The warning concerns people legally obligated to pray, not those exempt from the duty.

BIQAI:107:5/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BIQAI:107:5/r2.claim: Biqāʿī cites the Prophetic ruling that an adult woman's prayer is not accepted without a head covering; no grading is stated.
BIQAI:107:5/r2.anchor: مثل قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم : " لا يقبل الله صلاة حائض إلا بخمار "

BIQAI:107:5/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:107:5/r3.claim: The preposition ʿan, rather than fī, indicates neglecting prayer; it is rightly attributed to them because it is obligatory and benefits them through purification.
BIQAI:107:5/r3.anchor: قال : { عن } دون في { صلاتهم } ، أي هي جديرة بأن تضاف إليهم

BIQAI:107:5/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:107:5/r4.claim: Sāhūn means deeply heedless of prayer, neglecting it and showing little concern or regard.
BIQAI:107:5/r4.anchor: أي عريقون في الغفلة عنها ، وتضييعها ، وعدم المبالاة بها ، وقلة الالتفات إليها

BIQAI:107:5/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه
BIQAI:107:5/r5.claim: Ibn Masʿūd read lāhūn (“distracted”), which clarifies the habitual heedlessness meant.
BIQAI:107:5/r5.anchor: ويوضح ذلك أن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قرأ " لاهون "

BIQAI:107:5/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BIQAI:107:5/r6.claim: Al-Baghawī transmits that, when asked about the verse, the Prophet said it means letting prayer time lapse; no grading is stated.
BIQAI:107:5/r6.anchor: روى البغوي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل عن الآية فقال : " هو إضاعة الوقت "

BIQAI:107:5/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r7.speaker: ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
BIQAI:107:5/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says these are hypocrites who leave prayer when alone and perform it when present among people; no grading is stated.
BIQAI:107:5/r7.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أنه قال : هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة إذا غابوا ، ويصلونها إذا حضروا مع الناس

BIQAI:107:5/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:107:5/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI:107:5/r8.claim: The adjective portrays settled neglect so complete that they do not remember prayer by themselves; the next verse explains the pattern.
BIQAI:107:5/r8.anchor: وفائدة التعبير بالوصف الدلالة على ثبوته لهم ثبوتاً يوجب أن لا يذكروها من ذات أنفسهم أصلاً ، ولذلك كشفه بما بعده

DURR:107:5/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:107:5/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies them as hypocrites who display their prayers before people but leave them when unseen.
DURR:107:5/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس { فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هم المنافقون يراؤون الناس بصلاتهم إذا حضروا ، ويتركونها إذا غابوا

DURR:107:5/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:107:5/r2.claim: In the same report, Ibn ʿAbbās says the hypocrites spitefully refuse loaned household goods, which are al-maʿūn.
DURR:107:5/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس { فويل للمصلين الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هم المنافقون يراؤون الناس بصلاتهم إذا حضروا ، ويتركونها إذا غابوا ، ويمنعونهم العارية بغضاً لهم ، وهي الماعون

DURR:107:5/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:107:5/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās separately says the people in the verse are hypocrites: they pray openly and abandon prayer in private.
DURR:107:5/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هم المنافقون يتركون الصلاة في السر ، ويصلون في العلانية

DURR:107:5/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r4.speaker: مجاهد
DURR:107:5/r4.claim: Mujāhid also identifies those described as heedless of prayer as hypocrites.
DURR:107:5/r4.anchor: عن مجاهد { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هم المنافقون

DURR:107:5/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r5.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
DURR:107:5/r5.claim: Saʿd b. Abī Waqqāṣ explains that the phrase means wasting the prayer time, rather than ordinary distraction or inner self-talk during prayer.
DURR:107:5/r5.anchor: مصعب بن سعد قال : قلت لأبي : أرأيت قول الله

DURR:107:5/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن سعد بن أبي وقاص
DURR:107:5/r6.claim: A report from Saʿd attributes to the Prophet the explanation that they delay prayer beyond its proper time; al-Ḥākim and al-Bayhaqī say the mawqūf version is sounder.
DURR:107:5/r6.anchor: عن سعد بن أبي وقاص قال : سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن قوله : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هم الذين يؤخرون الصلاة

DURR:107:5/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r7.speaker: أبو برزة الأسلمي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR:107:5/r7.claim: A report with a weak chain says the verse is better than receiving the whole world: the negligent person neither hopes for prayer's reward nor fears God if he leaves prayer.
DURR:107:5/r7.anchor: عن أبي برزة الأسلمي قال : «لما نزلت هذه الآية { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

DURR:107:5/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR:107:5/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās glosses the phrase as delaying prayers beyond their appointed time.
DURR:107:5/r8.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : الذين يؤخرونها عن وقتها

DURR:107:5/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r9.speaker: مسروق
DURR:107:5/r9.claim: Masrūq explains it as neglecting the prayer's appointed time.
DURR:107:5/r9.anchor: عن مسروق { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : تضييع ميقاتها

DURR:107:5/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r10.speaker: أبو العالية
DURR:107:5/r10.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya says it describes someone who cannot remember whether he finished an even or odd number of prayer units.
DURR:107:5/r10.anchor: قال أبو العالية : هو الذي لا يدري عن كم انصرف عن شفع أو عن وتر

DURR:107:5/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r11.speaker: الحسن
DURR:107:5/r11.claim: Al-Ḥasan rejects Abū al-ʿĀliya's gloss about uncertainty over prayer units: the verse means letting prayer time pass until it is missed.
DURR:107:5/r11.anchor: فقال الحسن : مه ، هو الذي يسهو عن ميقاتها حتى تفوت

DURR:107:5/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r12.speaker: مجاهد
DURR:107:5/r12.claim: Mujāhid glosses sāhūn as lāhūn, meaning heedless or distracted.
DURR:107:5/r12.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله : { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : لاهون

DURR:107:5/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r13.speaker: ابن مسعود
DURR:107:5/r13.claim: Ibn Masʿūd is reported to have recited lāhūn in place of sāhūn.
DURR:107:5/r13.anchor: عن ابن مسعود أنه قرأ : «الذين هم عن صلاتهم لاهون »

DURR:107:5/r14.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r14.speaker: عطاء بن يسار
DURR:107:5/r14.claim: ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār notes the wording says they are heedless about their prayers, not heedless within the prayer itself.
DURR:107:5/r14.anchor: عن عطاء بن يسار قال : الحمد لله الذي قال : { هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } ولم يقل : في صلاتهم

DURR:107:5/r15.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r15.speaker: أبو العالية
DURR:107:5/r15.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya also describes someone who prays while turning to the right and left.
DURR:107:5/r15.anchor: عن أبي العالية { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : هو الذي يصلي ويقول : هكذا ، يعني يلتفت عن يمينه وعن يساره

DURR:107:5/r16.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r16.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
DURR:107:5/r16.claim: Zayd b. Aslam says they pray for show, and prayer is not truly part of their practice.
DURR:107:5/r16.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : يصلون رياء ، وليس الصلاة من شأنهم

DURR:107:5/r17.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:107:5/r17.speaker: قتادة
DURR:107:5/r17.claim: Qatāda describes them as indifferent to whether they pray at all.
DURR:107:5/r17.anchor: عن قتادة { عن صلاتهم ساهون } قال : لا يبالي عنها أصلى أم لم يصلّ

IBNASHUR:107:5/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:5/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:5/r1.claim: The relative clause restricts the woe to worshipers inattentive to their prayer, not worshipers generally, and further reinforces the mockery.
IBNASHUR:107:5/r1.anchor: صفة { للمصلين } مقيِّدة لحكم الموصوف فإن الويل للمصلي الساهي

IBNASHUR:107:5/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:5/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:5/r2.claim: Using ʿan with inattentive means they have gone beyond establishing prayer and abandoned it; the verse is unrelated to the legal rules for mistakes within prayer.
IBNASHUR:107:5/r2.anchor: وعدي { ساهون } بحرف { عن } لإفادة أنهم تجاوزوا إقامة صلاتهم وتركوها

IBNASHUR:107:5/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:5/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:5/r3.claim: One possible meaning is people who pray only for show and abandon prayer when alone.
IBNASHUR:107:5/r3.anchor: الذين لا يؤدون الصلاة إلاّ رياء فإذا خلوا تركوا الصلاة

IBNASHUR:107:5/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:5/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:5/r4.claim: Another possible meaning is people who pray without intention or sincerity, seeming heedless while praying; calling them heedless is mockery.
IBNASHUR:107:5/r4.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون معناه : الذين يصلون دون نية وإخلاص فهم

IBNASHUR:107:7/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:7/r3.speaker: هبة الله بن سلامة
IBNASHUR:107:7/r3.claim: Hibat Allah ibn Salama reports in al-Nasikh wa-l-Mansukh that these three verses were revealed about ʿAbd Allah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul.
IBNASHUR:107:7/r3.anchor: وحكى هبة الله بن سلامة في كتاب « الناسخ والمنسوخ »

IBNASHUR:107:7/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:7/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:7/r5.claim: Sahw literally means losing awareness of something previously known; here it is a mocking metaphor for deliberate turning away and abandonment.
IBNASHUR:107:7/r5.anchor: والسهو حقيقته :  الذهول عن أمر سبق علمه

IBNASHUR:107:7/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:7/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:7/r6.claim: The metaphor resembles saying that people forget their false gods, where forget means turn away from them.
IBNASHUR:107:7/r6.anchor: مثل قوله تعالى : { وتنسون ما تشركون } [ الأنعام : 41 ]

IBNASHUR:107:7/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:7/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:7/r7.claim: The author also compares metaphorical heedlessness with turning away from God's signs, in two other verses.
IBNASHUR:107:7/r7.anchor: ومثله استعارة الغفلة للإعراض في قوله تعالى

IBNASHUR:107:7/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:7/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:7/r8.claim: The threat is not for genuine forgetfulness in prayer, since forgetfulness is lifted from this community; the description instead mocks people called worshipers who do not pray.
IBNASHUR:107:7/r8.anchor: وليس المقصود الوعيد على السهو الحقيقي عن الصلاة

IBNASHUR:107:7/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:107:7/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:107:7/r9.claim: The ruling on real forgetfulness confirms the mockery: their label as worshipers describes people who in fact do not pray.
IBNASHUR:107:7/r9.anchor: وذلك ينادي على أن وصفهم بالمصلين تهكم بهم

IBNATIYYA:107:4/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r1.claim: A report places the revelation among people compelled into Islam in Mecca who were not firm, then succumbed to persecution and treated Muslims harshly; some prayed with them at times out of caution or confusion.
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r1.anchor: ويروى أن هذه السورة نزلت في بعض المضطرين في الإسلام بمكة الذين لم يحققوا فيه

IBNATIYYA:107:4/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r2.speaker: ابن جريج
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r2.claim: Ibn Jurayj says Abu Sufyan slaughtered a camel each week; when an orphan came, Abu Sufyan struck him with a stick, and the sura was revealed about him.
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r2.anchor: قال ابن جريج : كان أبو سفيان ينحر كل أسبوع جزوراً فجاءه يتيم ، فقرعه بعصا فنزلت السورة فيه

IBNATIYYA:107:4/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r3.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r3.claim: Saʿd ibn Abi Waqqas reports that the Prophet explained those heedless of prayer as people who delay it beyond its time.
IBNATIYYA:107:4/r3.anchor: وقال سعد بن أبي وقاص : سألت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن { الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون } ، فقال : هم الذين يؤخرونها عن وقتها

IBNATIYYA:107:4/r8.anchor: وفي قراءة ابن مسعود : «لاهون » بدل { ساهون }

IBNATIYYA:107:5/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r1.claim: A report places the revelation among people compelled into Islam in Mecca who were not firm, then succumbed to persecution and treated Muslims harshly; some prayed with them at times out of caution or confusion.
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r1.anchor: ويروى أن هذه السورة نزلت في بعض المضطرين في الإسلام بمكة الذين لم يحققوا فيه

IBNATIYYA:107:5/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r2.speaker: ابن جريج
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r2.claim: Ibn Jurayj says Abu Sufyan slaughtered a camel each week; when an orphan came, Abu Sufyan struck him with a stick, and the sura was revealed about him.
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r2.anchor: قال ابن جريج : كان أبو سفيان ينحر كل أسبوع جزوراً فجاءه يتيم ، فقرعه بعصا فنزلت السورة فيه

IBNATIYYA:107:5/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:107:5/r3.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r1.claim: The verse means those committed to prayer who are nevertheless heedless of it.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r1.anchor: أي : الذين هم من أهل الصلاة وقد التزموا بها ، ثم هم عنها ساهون

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r2.speaker: ابن عباس وغيره
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas and others say these are hypocrites who pray publicly but do not pray in private.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس ، وغيره : يعني المنافقين ، الذين يصلون في العلانية ولا يصلون في السر

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas takes heedlessness to include abandoning prayer altogether.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r3.anchor: عن فعلها بالكلية ، كما قاله ابن عباس

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r4.speaker: مسروق وأبو الضحى
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r4.claim: Masruq and Abu al-Duha interpret it as failing to perform prayer within its legally prescribed time.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r4.anchor: في الوقت المقدر لها شرعا ، فيخرجها عن وقتها بالكلية ، كما قاله مسروق ، وأبو الضحى

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r5.speaker: عطاء بن دينار
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r5.claim: Ataa b. Dinar notes that the verse says heedless about their prayer, not heedless within prayer.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r5.anchor: وقال عطاء بن دينار : والحمد لله الذي قال : { عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ } ولم يقل : في صلاتهم ساهون

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r6.claim: Another form is habitual delay from the prayer's first time until its end.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r6.anchor: وإما عن وقتها الأول فيؤخرونها إلى آخره دائما أو غالبا

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r7.claim: The phrase also covers failing to perform prayer with its commanded pillars and conditions.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r7.anchor: وإما عن أدائها بأركانها وشروطها على الوجه المأمور به

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r8.claim: It also covers lack of reverence in prayer and reflection on its meanings.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r8.anchor: وإما عن الخشوع فيها والتدبر لمعانيها

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r9.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r9.claim: The wording includes all these forms; anyone with one has a share of the verse, while someone with all completes his share and practical hypocrisy.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r9.anchor: فاللفظ يشمل هذا كله ، ولكل من اتصف بشيء من ذلك قسط من هذه الآية

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r10.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r10.claim: The Prophet calls the prayer of a hypocrite one repeated three times: he waits for the sun to near the devil's horns, then pecks out four units with little remembrance.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r10.anchor: كما ثبت في الصحيحين أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r11.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r11.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r11.claim: Ibn Kathir identifies this as the middle prayer, Asr, delayed to its last and disliked time; the worshipper then pecks like a crow without composure or reverence.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r11.anchor: فهذا آخر صلاة العصر التي هي الوسطى ، كما ثبت به النص إلى آخر وقتها ، وهو وقت كراهة

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r12.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r12.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r12.claim: Ibn Kathir suspects that ostentation, rather than seeking God's favor, motivated the hypocrite to pray, so in effect he had not prayed at all.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r12.anchor: ولعله إنما حمله على القيام إليها مراءاة الناس ، لا ابتغاء وجه الله ، فهو إذًا لم يصل بالكلية

IBNKATHIR:107:4/r13.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r13.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r13.claim: He links the hypocrites' lazy, showy prayer and scant remembrance to the description of hypocrites in 4:142.
IBNKATHIR:107:4/r13.anchor: ولا يذكرون الله إلا قليلا } [ النساء : 142 ]

IBNKATHIR:107:6/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r7.claim: In Abu Barza's report, the Prophet says the heedless person who expects no good from prayer and fears no Lord when abandoning it is worse off than receiving the whole world; the chain is weak because Jabir al-Juʿfi is weak and his teacher unnamed.
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r7.anchor: عن أبي برزة الأسلمي قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR:107:6/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r8.claim: Saʿd b. Abi Waqqas asks about the heedless; the Prophet answers that they delay prayer beyond its time. The raised route is weakened, while the mawquf report from Saʿd is more sound and was authenticated by al-Bayhaqi and al-Hakim.
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r8.anchor: عن مصعب بن سعد ، عن سعد بن أبي وقاص قال : سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR:107:6/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r9.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r9.claim: Delaying prayer beyond its time may mean abandoning it, praying after its legally set time, or postponing it from its first time until the time expires.
IBNKATHIR:107:6/r9.anchor: يحتمل تركها بالكلية ، أو صلاتها بعد وقتها شرعا

KASHSHAF:107:5/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:107:5/r1.claim: They neglect prayer through indifference, letting it lapse or delaying it beyond its time.
KASHSHAF:107:5/r1.anchor: الذين يسهون عن الصلاة قلة مبالاة بها ،   حتى تفوتهم أو يخرج وقتها

KASHSHAF:107:5/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:107:5/r2.claim: They may also rush prayer instead of following the Prophet and the early generations, lacking humility and ignoring disliked acts such as fidgeting, yawning, and looking around.
KASHSHAF:107:5/r2.anchor: أو لا يصلونها كما صلاها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم والسلف ،   ولكن ينقرونها نقراً من غير خشوع وإخبات

KASHSHAF:107:5/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:107:5/r3.claim: Examples include playing with beard or clothes, excessive yawning, looking around, and not knowing how many units they finished or what they recited, as with many ostentatious worshippers.
KASHSHAF:107:5/r3.anchor: من العبث باللحية ،   والثياب ،   وكثرة التثاؤب ،   والالتفات

KASHSHAF:107:5/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:107:5/r4.claim: Their neglect of prayer, the pillar distinguishing faith from unbelief, their ostentation, a branch of associating partners, and withholding zakāh, prayer's counterpart, expose them as deniers of judgment; even some scholars display this trait.
KASHSHAF:107:5/r4.anchor: التي هي عماد الدين ،   والفارق بين الإيمان والكفر والرياء الذي هو شعبة من الشرك

KASHSHAF:107:5/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:107:5/r5.claim: Another syntax coordinates fa-dhālika with the denier, as a noun or description; the answer to “Have you seen?” is omitted and indicated by what follows, and the plural denotes the generic singular.
KASHSHAF:107:5/r5.anchor: وطريقة أخرى : أن يكون { فَذَلِكَ } عطفاً على { الذي يُكَذّبُ }

KASHSHAF:107:5/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:107:5/r6.claim: ʿAn ṣalātihim means neglecting or turning away from prayer, characteristic of hypocrites or shameless sinners; fī ṣalātihim would mean distraction within prayer, which afflicts any Muslim, even the Prophet, and occasions prostration for forgetfulness.
KASHSHAF:107:5/r6.anchor: أنهم ساهون عنها سهو ترك لها

KASHSHAF:107:5/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r7.speaker: أنس رضي الله عنه
KASHSHAF:107:5/r7.claim: Anas praised God that the wording says “about their prayer” rather than “in their prayer.”
KASHSHAF:107:5/r7.anchor: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه : الحمد لله على أن لم يقل في صلاتهم

KASHSHAF:107:5/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:107:5/r8.speaker: ابن مسعود
KASHSHAF:107:5/r8.anchor: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه : الحمد لله على أن لم يقل في صلاتهم .   وقرأ ابن مسعود : «لاهون »

MAWARDI:107:4/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:4/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI:107:4/r2.claim: Alternatively, the omitted qualification is supplied explicitly by the connected phrase that follows: “those who are heedless of their prayer.”
MAWARDI:107:4/r2.anchor: الثاني : أن إضماره ظاهر متصل به ، وهو قوله تعالى : { الذين هم } الآية .

MAWARDI:107:5/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI:107:5/r1.claim: This phrase makes explicit the qualification implied in the preceding warning.
MAWARDI:107:5/r1.anchor: إضماراً فيها ، وإن كان نطقاً ظاهراً .

MAWARDI:107:5/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI:107:5/r2.claim: The blame is not for involuntary distraction that overtakes a person during prayer and cannot be prevented, since that is forgiven.
MAWARDI:107:5/r2.anchor: وليس السهو الذي يطرأ عليه في صلاته ولا يقدر على دفعه عن نفسه هو الذي ذم به ؛ لأنه عفو .

MAWARDI:107:5/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r3.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI:107:5/r3.claim: Mujahid says the blameworthy heedlessness means being distracted and inattentive.
MAWARDI:107:5/r3.anchor: أحدها : أن معنى ساهون أي لاهون ، قاله مجاهد .

MAWARDI:107:5/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r4.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI:107:5/r4.claim: Qatada glosses it as being heedless.

MAWARDI:107:5/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r5.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI:107:5/r5.claim: Al-Hasan says they hide the prayer but perform it publicly to display it before believers.
MAWARDI:107:5/r5.anchor: الثالث : أن لا يصليها سراً ، ويصليها علانية رياء للمؤمنين ، قاله الحسن .

MAWARDI:107:5/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
MAWARDI:107:5/r6.claim: Abu al-ʿAliya says it describes someone who turns right and left, treating prayer contemptuously.
MAWARDI:107:5/r6.anchor: الرابع : هو الذي يلتفت يمنة ويسرة هواناً بصلاته ، قاله أبو العالية .

MAWARDI:107:5/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r7.speaker: قطرب
MAWARDI:107:5/r7.claim: Qutrub says it means not reciting or remembering God.
MAWARDI:107:5/r7.anchor: الخامس : هو ألا يقرأ ولا يذكر الله ، قاله قطرب .

MAWARDI:107:5/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:107:5/r8.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
MAWARDI:107:5/r8.claim: Saʿd b. Abi Waqqas reports that the Prophet explained them as people who delay prayer past its appointed times.
MAWARDI:107:5/r8.anchor: السادس : هو ما روى مصعب بن سعد بن أبي وقاص عن أبيه قال : سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

NASAFI:107:4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:107:4/r1.claim: The warning continues by specifying the worshippers meant: those heedless of prayer, who show off and withhold alms or useful aid.
NASAFI:107:4/r1.anchor: { فَوَيْلٌ لّلْمُصَلّينَ الذين هُمْ عَن صلاتهم سَاهُونَ الذين هُمْ يُرَاءونَ

NASAFI:107:4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:107:4/r2.claim: One explanation identifies hypocrites: they avoid private prayer because they do not believe it obligatory, but pray publicly to show off.
NASAFI:107:4/r2.anchor: يعني بهذا المنافقين لا يصلونها سراً ؛ لأنهم لا يعتقدون وجوبها

NASAFI:107:4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI:107:4/r3.claim: Another description is hypocrites who outwardly count themselves among worshippers but neglect prayer, seek neither nearness nor fulfillment of duty, go through motions mindlessly, display worship, and withhold alms and useful things.
NASAFI:107:4/r3.anchor: وقيل : فويل للمنافقين الذين يدخلون أنفسهم في جملة المصلين صورة

NASAFI:107:4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r4.speaker: أنس والحسن
NASAFI:107:4/r4.claim: Anas and al-Ḥasan say “about their prayer” means neglecting and turning away from it, the behavior of hypocrites; “within their prayer” would mean distraction by Satan or one's thoughts, which also befalls Muslims, including the Prophet.
NASAFI:107:4/r4.anchor: وعن أنس والحسن قالا : الحمد لله الذي قال { عَن صلاتهم } ولم يقل

NASAFI:107:4/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r5.speaker: أنس والحسن
NASAFI:107:4/r5.claim: They distinguish forgetfulness “in prayer,” caused by Satanic whisper or one's thoughts, from neglecting prayer; this ordinary distraction may affect any Muslim, and the Prophet himself sometimes forgot in prayer.
NASAFI:107:4/r5.anchor: ومعنى «في » أن السهو يعتريهم فيها بوسوسة شيطان أو حديث نفس

NASAFI:107:4/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r6.speaker: author
NASAFI:107:4/r6.claim: Riyāʾ is a reciprocal form from showing: the performer displays his deed to people, who respond with praise and admiration.
NASAFI:107:4/r6.anchor: والمراءاة مفاعلة من الإراءة ؛ لأن المرائي يرائي الناس عمله

NASAFI:107:4/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:107:4/r7.speaker: author
NASAFI:107:4/r7.claim: Displaying obligatory worship is not showing off because it should be public; concealing voluntary worship is better, unless it is displayed to encourage imitation, which is good.
NASAFI:107:4/r7.anchor: ولا يكون الرجل مرائياً بإظهار الفرائض
